notes: Built on 2026-10-09 from public web sources only, without opening any local project files. 16 of 18 listed sources were fetched; sources 17 (Lattice) and 18 (Microchip) failed and are never cited. Other fetch failures, worked around with other copies: altera.com IP catalog (HTTP 403) and intel.com FPGA IP/doc pages (404), so older official Altera documents were used; Cambridge UP TOC PDF for Dally & Harting (timed out), so archive.org/Google Books chapter lists were used; O'Reilly TOC for Harris & Harris (403), so the Library of Congress TOC was used; web.archive.org (blocked for the fetch tool); AMD answer record 000037919 (did not render). Method: category and item names were collected verbatim from each source; they were grouped into areas at about the level of an IP-catalog sub-category; an area was kept only if at least one fetched source lists it. Each area records the verbatim strings that back it (evidence, keyed by source number), and every string was checked by script against the saved raw text of that source. Scope: synthesizable digital logic only. Left out on purpose: analog parts (ADCs/DACs, PLL/DLL circuits, oscillators, regulators, SerDes and other PHY circuits, I/O pad libraries, standard cells, memory bit-cell macros), board-level items (prototype boards, systems-on-module, dev kits), software stacks and EDA tools (ATPG, diagnosis, yield), and verification-only items (verification IP, simulation-only modules, testbench utilities). Digital controllers for analog parts (ADC sequencers, clock dividers and gating, memory controllers) and digital test logic (TAP, boundary scan, scan, BIST, trace, debug) are kept. Boundaries between areas: dual-clock FIFOs are counted under clock-domain crossing, not under FIFOs; LFSR-based PRBS generators under LFSRs; DMA engines under interconnect; interrupt controllers and arbiters under control; line coding, CRC, ECC and FEC form a separate "data integrity" family. Groups used: arithmetic (12), logic (11), control (3), memory (11), interconnect (11), interface (12), peripherals (4), processor (5), DSP (7), data integrity (4), crypto (7), video/image (8), accelerators (3), networking (5), test/debug (8), clocking/reset/power (5), other (3). Caveats: source 3 reflects Altera's 2010-2012 catalog, not the current one; source 7 is cited only where a chapter title names the area; 10 areas rest on a single source (A041 Cache-coherent interconnects; A067 Branch prediction; A068 Superscalar, out-of-order and multithreaded execution structures; A076 Radio digital front-end (pre-distortion, crest-factor reduction); A096 AI/ML and computer-vision accelerators; A097 Lossless data-compression engines; A103 Wireless baseband and modem processing (5G/LTE, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, UWB, GNSS); A106 Logic BIST and in-system test controllers; A107 Memory BIST and repair; A113 Digital PLLs and clock recovery) - they are real catalog or textbook entries but have thinner support. Each source entry lists the categories it has that were judged out of scope or too generic to map.

kinds.description: Produces successive beat addresses for incrementing or wrapping bursts, keeping base address, beat index, and size registers.

kinds.name: Memory-map address decoder
kinds.description: Compares an incoming address against programmed region descriptors and selects a target slave.

kinds.name: Network-on-chip router
kinds.description: Switches flits between input and output ports, keeping per-port input buffers, route fields, and switch configuration registers.

kinds.name: Virtual channel allocator
kinds.description: Assigns free output virtual channels to waiting input channels, keeping per-VC state and allocation registers.

kinds.name: Wormhole route computation unit
kinds.description: Computes the output port for a head flit from destination coordinates, storing the chosen port per input channel.

kinds.name: Packet reassembly buffer
kinds.description: Collects fragments of a packet into contiguous storage using a segment memory, offset register, and received-length counter.

kinds.name: Weighted fair queue scheduler
kinds.description: Selects among queues according to per-queue weights and virtual-time counters held in a scheduling state array.

kinds.name: Hardware priority queue
kinds.description: Maintains a binary heap of keyed entries in a memory array with a size register and sift-up/sift-down index registers.

kinds.name: Sorting network
kinds.description: Sorts a fixed number of parallel values through a fixed pattern of compare-exchange stages, with optional stage registers.

kinds.name: Bitonic merge unit
kinds.description: Merges two sorted sequences through log-depth compare-exchange stages, keeping per-stage pipeline registers.

kinds.name: Hash table lookup engine
kinds.description: Hashes a key, probes bucket memory, and compares stored keys, keeping probe index, bucket data, and match registers.

kinds.name: Bloom filter
kinds.description: Sets and tests several hashed bit positions in a bit-vector memory to answer approximate membership queries.

kinds.name: LIFO stack
kinds.description: Stores pushed words in a memory array addressed by a top-of-stack pointer register.

kinds.name: Free-list manager
kinds.description: Allocates and recycles buffer identifiers through a linked-list memory with head and tail pointer registers.

kinds.name: Bitmap allocator
kinds.description: Tracks free blocks as bits in a bitmap memory and selects the first clear bit for allocation.

kinds.name: Timer/counter peripheral
kinds.description: Counts clock ticks or external events with load, compare, and control registers plus an interrupt flag.

kinds.name: Real-time clock
kinds.description: Maintains seconds, minutes, hours, and calendar fields in dedicated registers updated by a one-hertz tick.

kinds.name: Cycle timestamp counter
kinds.description: Provides a free-running wide cycle count readable as a register pair with a latched snapshot register.

kinds.name: Serial-in parallel-out shift register
kinds.description: Shifts in bits one per cycle and exposes the accumulated word in parallel from its storage flops.

kinds.name: Frequency meter
kinds.description: Counts edges of an unknown clock over a reference gate interval, keeping an event counter, gate counter, and result latch.

kinds.name: Time-to-digital converter
kinds.description: Measures the interval between two edges using a tapped delay chain plus a coarse cycle counter, latching both codes.

kinds.name: Quadrature decoder
kinds.description: Derives position and direction from two phase-shifted encoder inputs, keeping previous-sample flops and a position counter.

kinds.name: Stepper motor sequencer
kinds.description: Drives coil phase patterns in order at a programmable step rate, keeping a phase index register and step-rate divider.

kinds.name: Program counter unit
kinds.description: Supplies the next instruction address from increment, branch, or exception sources, holding the current address register.

kinds.name: First-order sigma-delta DAC
kinds.description: Converts a multi-bit sample to a one-bit density stream using an error accumulator register.

kinds.name: Decimation filter
kinds.description: Low-pass filters and downsamples an oversampled stream, keeping filter state registers and a decimation phase counter.

kinds.name: PDM-to-PCM converter
kinds.description: Turns a one-bit density stream into multi-bit samples through cascaded integrators and combs, keeping their accumulator and delay registers.

kinds.name: FIR filter
kinds.description: Computes a weighted sum of recent samples using a tapped delay line of sample registers and a coefficient memory.

kinds.name: IIR biquad section
kinds.description: Implements a second-order recursive filter stage with two delay-state registers and coefficient registers.

kinds.name: CIC filter
kinds.description: Performs rate conversion with cascaded integrator and comb stages, holding integrator accumulators and comb delay registers.

kinds.name: Polyphase resampler
kinds.description: Changes sample rate using sub-filter banks selected by a phase accumulator, keeping sample history and phase registers.

kinds.name: FFT butterfly unit
kinds.description: Combines two complex operands with a twiddle factor into two outputs, with pipeline registers for the complex intermediates.

kinds.name: Twiddle address generator
kinds.description: Produces coefficient ROM addresses for each FFT stage and index, keeping stage and butterfly-index counters.

kinds.name: Window function multiplier
kinds.description: Scales incoming samples by coefficients read from a window ROM addressed by a sample-index counter.

kinds.name: Numerically controlled oscillator
kinds.description: Generates sine and cosine samples by advancing a phase accumulator register and looking up a waveform table.

kinds.name: PID controller
kinds.description: Computes a control output from proportional, integral, and derivative terms, keeping an integral accumulator and previous-error register.

kinds.name: Automatic gain control loop
kinds.description: Adjusts an applied gain from measured signal amplitude, keeping an amplitude estimate register and a gain register.

kinds.name: Correlator
kinds.description: Slides a reference sequence against an input stream and accumulates products, keeping a sample shift register and accumulator.

kinds.name: Peak detector
kinds.description: Tracks the largest magnitude seen within a window, keeping peak-value and peak-index registers plus a window counter.

kinds.name: Moving-average filter
kinds.description: Outputs the mean of the last N samples using a sample delay memory and a running-sum register.

kinds.name: Median filter
kinds.description: Outputs the middle value of a sliding sample window held in a small register array with a sorting network.

kinds.name: Image line buffer
kinds.description: Stores one or more complete image rows in memory so a kernel can access vertically adjacent pixels, with row write and read pointers.

kinds.name: 2D sliding-window generator
kinds.description: Assembles a KxK pixel neighborhood each cycle from line buffers into a register window array.

kinds.name: Color space converter
kinds.description: Applies a fixed matrix transform between color representations, keeping coefficient registers and an optional output pipeline register.

kinds.name: Gamma lookup table
kinds.description: Maps input intensity values through a writable table memory to corrected output values.

kinds.name: Alpha blender
kinds.description: Mixes foreground and background pixels using an alpha weight, with optional registered pixel outputs.

kinds.name: Video timing generator
kinds.description: Produces horizontal and vertical sync and blanking signals from pixel and line counters and programmed timing registers.

kinds.name: Framebuffer scanout controller
kinds.description: Reads pixel data from memory in raster order to feed a display, keeping a base-address register, current-address counter, and line counter.

kinds.name: Character display generator
kinds.description: Renders text by fetching character codes and font rows, keeping a character memory, font ROM, and row/column counters.

kinds.name: Bilinear video scaler
kinds.description: Interpolates output pixels from neighboring input pixels using fractional position accumulators and line-buffer state.

kinds.name: Bayer demosaic unit
kinds.description: Reconstructs full-color pixels from a mosaic sensor pattern using neighborhood registers and a phase indicator for the filter position.

kinds.name: Zigzag scan reorder buffer
kinds.description: Reorders an 8x8 coefficient block between raster and zigzag order using a block memory and an index-sequence ROM.

kinds.name: Discrete cosine transform unit
kinds.description: Transforms a block of samples into frequency coefficients through row and column passes, keeping an intermediate block memory.

kinds.name: Run-length encoder
kinds.description: Emits value and repeat-count pairs from a stream, keeping a current-value register and a run-length counter.

kinds.name: Huffman decoder
kinds.description: Consumes a variable-length bitstream and emits symbols using code-table memories, keeping a bit-accumulator register and bit-position counter.

kinds.name: LZ77 match finder
kinds.description: Searches a history window for the longest match with current input, keeping a history memory, candidate position registers, and match-length register.

kinds.name: PS/2 keyboard interface
kinds.description: Receives serial scan-code frames clocked by the device, keeping a shift register, bit counter, and code output register.

kinds.name: Seven-segment display multiplexer
kinds.description: Time-multiplexes digit drive lines across several displays, keeping a digit-index counter and per-digit value registers.

kinds.name: LED matrix scanner
kinds.description: Drives rows sequentially while presenting column data, keeping a row counter and a frame bitmap memory.

kinds.name: GPIO port
kinds.description: Provides software-controlled pin output, input sampling, and direction, keeping output-data, direction, and input-capture registers.

kinds.name: Pin mux controller
kinds.description: Selects which internal function drives each physical pad using per-pin function-select registers.

kinds.name: Shadowed configuration register bank
kinds.description: Accepts writes into shadow registers and transfers them to active registers on a commit strobe.

kinds.name: Hardware semaphore block
kinds.description: Provides test-and-set lock cells that record the owning requester id and a locked flag per cell.

kinds.name: Atomic compare-and-swap unit
kinds.description: Reads a memory location, compares it to an expected value, and conditionally writes, keeping read-data, expected, and success-flag registers.

kinds.name: Barrier synchronization unit
kinds.description: Tracks which participants have arrived using an arrival bit vector and releases them with a sense-reversal flag.

kinds.name: Doorbell register block
kinds.description: Lets a remote agent set notification bits that a local agent reads and clears, keeping per-channel pending bits.

kinds.name: Interrupt status aggregator
kinds.description: Combines many source events into a summary line, keeping raw-status, mask, and masked-status registers.

kinds.name: DMA descriptor fetch engine
kinds.description: Reads descriptor structures from memory and loads transfer parameters, keeping descriptor-pointer, parameter, and fetch-state registers.

kinds.name: Scatter-gather address translator
kinds.description: Walks a list of memory segments to map a linear transfer offset onto physical addresses, keeping segment-index and residual-length registers.

kinds.name: SDRAM bank controller
kinds.description: Issues activate, read, write, and precharge commands for one bank, keeping open-row address, bank state, and timing counters.

kinds.name: DRAM refresh scheduler
kinds.description: Generates periodic refresh commands and tracks deferrals, keeping an interval counter and a pending-refresh counter.

kinds.name: NAND flash controller
kinds.description: Sequences command, address, and data cycles to a flash device, keeping a command state machine, page buffer, and status register.

kinds.name: SD card host controller
kinds.description: Issues command/response transactions and block data transfers, keeping argument, response, and transfer-state registers.

kinds.name: QSPI execute-in-place controller
kinds.description: Converts memory read requests into quad serial flash commands, keeping command configuration registers and a prefetch data register.

kinds.name: Wear-leveling mapping table
kinds.description: Translates logical to physical blocks and records per-block erase counts in a mapping memory.

kinds.name: Activation function LUT
kinds.description: Maps an input value to a nonlinear output using a piecewise table memory with optional interpolation registers.

kinds.name: Requantization unit
kinds.description: Rescales wide accumulator values to a narrow output format using multiplier and shift configuration registers.

kinds.name: Argmax unit
kinds.description: Scans a stream of values to report the index of the largest, keeping best-value, best-index, and position-counter registers.

kinds.name: Johnson ring counter
kinds.description: Circulates a pattern through a shift register whose last bit is inverted back into the first stage.

kinds.name: AND gate
kinds.description: Outputs logic 1 only when all of its inputs are 1, and keeps no registers or memory.

kinds.name: OR gate
kinds.description: Outputs logic 1 when any of its inputs is 1, and holds no internal state.

kinds.name: NOT gate (inverter)
kinds.description: Outputs the logical complement of its single input, with no stored state.

kinds.name: NAND gate
kinds.description: Outputs the complement of the AND of its inputs, and keeps no registers or memory.

kinds.name: NOR gate
kinds.description: Outputs the complement of the OR of its inputs, and holds no internal state.

kinds.name: Non-inverting buffer
kinds.description: Passes its input to its output unchanged to restore drive strength, and keeps no state.

kinds.name: Tri-state buffer
kinds.description: Drives its input onto the output when enabled and leaves the output high-impedance otherwise, holding no stored state.

kinds.name: AND-OR-Invert (AOI21) gate
kinds.description: Computes the complement of (A AND B) OR C in a single compound stage, with no internal storage.

kinds.name: OR-AND-Invert (OAI21) gate
kinds.description: Computes the complement of (A OR B) AND C in a single compound stage, keeping no registers.

kinds.name: AND-OR (AO22) gate
kinds.description: Computes (A AND B) OR (C AND D) as a non-inverting compound gate, with no stored state.

kinds.name: OR-AND (OA22) gate
kinds.description: Computes (A OR B) AND (C OR D) as a non-inverting compound gate, holding no memory.

kinds.name: Majority gate
kinds.description: Outputs the value held by more than half of its odd number of inputs, and keeps no state.

kinds.name: Minority gate
kinds.description: Outputs the complement of the majority value of its inputs, with no registers or memory.

kinds.name: Implication (IMPLY) gate
kinds.description: Outputs NOT A OR B, realizing logical implication from A to B, and is stateless.

kinds.name: Inhibit gate
kinds.description: Outputs A AND NOT B so that one input vetoes the other, and holds no internal state.

kinds.name: Muller C-element
kinds.description: Sets its output to the common input value when all inputs agree and otherwise holds its previous output, keeping that one output bit as state.

kinds.name: Threshold gate
kinds.description: Outputs 1 when the weighted sum of its binary inputs reaches a fixed threshold, with no stored state.

kinds.name: Transmission gate
kinds.description: Acts as a bidirectional switch that connects or isolates two nodes under a control signal and its complement, keeping no memory.

kinds.name: Open-drain driver
kinds.description: Pulls its output low when its input is asserted and otherwise releases it for an external pull-up, enabling wired-AND buses, with no internal state.

kinds.name: Schmitt-trigger inverter
kinds.description: Inverts its input using separate rising and falling switching thresholds, its only state being the current output level that provides hysteresis.

kinds.name: Toffoli gate
kinds.description: A reversible three-input gate that passes two control inputs through and flips the third input when both controls are 1, holding no stored state.

kinds.name: Fredkin gate
kinds.description: A reversible controlled-swap gate that exchanges its two data inputs when the control input is 1, with no registers or memory.

kinds.name: Bus keeper
kinds.description: Weakly drives a shared line back to its last driven value when every driver goes high-impedance, storing that single last-seen bit.

kinds.name: Registered-select multiplexer
kinds.description: Routes one of N data inputs to the output using a select code that is captured into a select register on a load strobe, so the routing changes only when the register is updated.

kinds.name: One-hot AND-OR multiplexer
kinds.description: Combines inputs by ANDing each with its own bit of a one-hot select register and ORing the results into the output, holding only that one-hot select register.

kinds.name: Time-division multiplexer
kinds.description: Steps a slot counter through the inputs in a fixed repeating schedule and forwards the input owned by the current slot, keeping the slot counter and a programmable slot-count register.

kinds.name: Priority multiplexer
kinds.description: Forwards the data of the highest-priority input whose valid line is asserted, keeping a registered copy of the chosen data and the index of the input it came from.

kinds.name: Tri-state bus multiplexer
kinds.description: Lets one of several sources drive a shared bus by enabling a single tri-state driver, holding a register of per-source output-enable bits.

kinds.name: Packet-boundary stream multiplexer
kinds.description: Merges several packet streams onto one output and only changes source at end-of-packet, keeping a current-source register and an in-packet lock flag.

kinds.name: Byte-lane steering multiplexer
kinds.description: Routes each output byte lane from the input byte lane chosen by an address offset and transfer size, holding the registered offset and size that drive the lane selects.

kinds.name: ADC channel scan multiplexer
kinds.description: Steps through a programmed list of analog input channels to feed a converter, keeping a channel-list memory, a list-index pointer and a settle-delay counter.

kinds.name: Redundancy repair multiplexer
kinds.description: Steers data around a faulty memory column or lane to a spare, keeping a repair-address register loaded from fuses and a repair-enable bit.

kinds.name: Sample-and-hold multiplexer
kinds.description: Selects one input on a sample strobe and keeps presenting that captured value until the next strobe, storing the held data and the select code it was taken from.

kinds.name: Zero-insertion multiplexer
kinds.description: Forwards the selected input when it is marked valid and otherwise drives a constant default such as zero, keeping a select register and a per-input valid mask register.

kinds.name: Break-before-make multiplexer
kinds.description: Changes source by first deselecting all inputs for a programmable number of dead cycles and then enabling the new one, keeping the current select, the pending select and a dead-time counter.

kinds.name: Context-select multiplexer
kinds.description: Chooses which of several stored configuration contexts drives a datapath, keeping the context register banks and an active-context index register.

kinds.name: Read-response return multiplexer
kinds.description: Routes read data back from whichever target answered a request to the requester, keeping a table of outstanding transaction IDs mapped to source ports.

kinds.name: Latency-matched bank read multiplexer
kinds.description: Selects the read data of the memory bank that was addressed several cycles earlier, keeping a pipeline of delayed bank-select codes.

kinds.name: Failover source multiplexer
kinds.description: Forwards a primary source and switches to a backup when the primary is reported faulty, keeping a health-status register and an active-source flag.

kinds.name: Header insertion multiplexer
kinds.description: Outputs words from a header register file first and then switches to the payload stream, keeping the header registers and a phase counter that tracks header progress.

kinds.name: Bitwise masked merge multiplexer
kinds.description: Builds each output bit from one of two inputs according to the matching bit of a mask register, keeping the per-bit mask register.

kinds.name: Registered 1-to-N demultiplexer
kinds.description: Steers one input word onto the output chosen by a select code and holds every output in its own register, with the select itself captured in a select register.

kinds.name: Addressable latch demultiplexer
kinds.description: Writes a single data bit into whichever of N output latches the address selects, leaving all unselected latches holding their previous values in an N-bit latch bank.

kinds.name: Packet-boundary stream demultiplexer
kinds.description: Captures a destination field at start-of-packet into a route register and steers every beat of that packet to the chosen output until end-of-packet, tracking an in-packet flag.

kinds.name: Valid/ready stream demultiplexer
kinds.description: Forwards a handshaked input to one selected output channel, propagating that channel's ready back upstream, and keeps a registered select plus a per-output valid register.

kinds.name: Time-division slot demultiplexer
kinds.description: Distributes successive time slots of a single TDM stream to N output channels using a slot counter and a frame-sync flag, latching each slot's data into its channel register.

kinds.name: Round-robin work distributor
kinds.description: Sends each incoming item to the next output in rotation, keeping a next-output pointer register that advances on every accepted item.

kinds.name: Least-loaded dispatcher
kinds.description: Routes each incoming request to the output whose queue is currently least occupied, maintaining a per-output occupancy counter array and a registered chosen-index.

kinds.name: Multicast mask demultiplexer
kinds.description: Copies one input to any subset of outputs given by a destination bitmask, storing the mask register and a per-output delivered-flag register until all copies are accepted.

kinds.name: Flow-hash steering demultiplexer
kinds.description: Hashes header fields of each incoming packet and uses the hash to index an indirection table that names the destination queue, storing the hash register and the programmable table.

kinds.name: EtherType protocol demultiplexer
kinds.description: Extracts the protocol-type field from each frame header into a type register and steers the frame to the matching protocol queue via a programmable type-to-queue match table.

kinds.name: Virtual-channel input demultiplexer
kinds.description: Places each arriving flit into the buffer of the virtual channel named in its header, keeping per-VC flit buffers and a current-VC register for multi-flit packets.

kinds.name: Memory bank-steering demultiplexer
kinds.description: Routes each memory request to one of several interleaved banks chosen by low-order address bits, holding a per-bank pending-request register and the decoded bank index.

kinds.name: Multi-lane striping distributor
kinds.description: Spreads a single word stream across several physical lanes in fixed rotation and periodically inserts alignment markers, keeping a lane pointer and a marker-interval counter.

kinds.name: Event routing demultiplexer
kinds.description: Delivers a single event or interrupt pulse to one of N target cores according to a programmable routing register, recording the event in a per-target pending flag.

kinds.name: Cross-domain pulse demultiplexer
kinds.description: Routes a pulse from a source clock domain to one of N outputs in a destination domain by flipping a per-output toggle register and detecting the toggle with synchronizer flops on the receiving side.

kinds.name: Scan-chain select demultiplexer
kinds.description: Directs the test scan-in stream to one of several internal scan chains chosen by a chain-select instruction register loaded through the test port.

kinds.name: Pipelined demultiplexer tree
kinds.description: Fans a single input out across several levels of small registered demultiplexer stages, each level carrying its own pipelined slice of the select code alongside the data register.

kinds.name: Error-sinking demultiplexer
kinds.description: Routes inputs to the output named by the select code but diverts any out-of-range select to a dedicated error sink, capturing the offending select value in an error-address register and setting an error flag.

kinds.name: Auto-increment register loader
kinds.description: Writes successive incoming words into consecutive destination registers by using an internal write-index register as the select code, which advances after each write and can be reloaded with a base index.

kinds.name: Write-strobe demultiplexer
kinds.description: Converts a registered register-bank address and a single write enable into a one-of-N write strobe for the addressed register, holding the captured address and data until the strobe fires.

kinds.name: Registered-output one-hot decoder
kinds.description: Decodes an n-bit input into 2^n lines and captures the result in an output flip-flop bank each clock, keeping only that registered one-hot word.

kinds.name: Two-level predecoder
kinds.description: Splits the address into fields, decodes each field into small one-hot groups, and ANDs the groups to form the final lines, with an optional latch holding the predecoded group outputs.

kinds.name: SRAM wordline decoder with pulse latch
kinds.description: Decodes a row address into a single wordline and fires it for a self-timed pulse, keeping a latched row address and a pulse-active flip-flop.

kinds.name: DRAM row decoder with RAS address latch
kinds.description: Captures the row address on the row strobe and decodes it to drive one row line until precharge, keeping the latched row address and a row-open flag.

kinds.name: Redundancy-steering row decoder
kinds.description: Decodes a row address but compares it against fuse-loaded repair addresses and activates a spare row instead on a match, keeping the repair address registers and their enable bits.

kinds.name: Binary-to-thermometer decoder
kinds.description: Converts an n-bit value into a 2^n-line thermometer code in which all lines up to the value are asserted, typically driving unary DAC segments, with an optional output register.

kinds.name: Byte-lane strobe decoder
kinds.description: Turns the low address bits and an access-size field into per-byte write-enable strobes for a wide data bus, holding a registered copy of the strobes for the data phase.

kinds.name: Range mask decoder
kinds.description: Takes start and end bit indices and produces a contiguous mask of asserted lines between them, as used for bit-field insert and extract, holding the start and end index registers.

kinds.name: Timing-phase decoder
kinds.description: Steps a small binary phase counter and decodes it into one-hot phase-enable strobes that sequence a multi-cycle operation, keeping the phase counter.

kinds.name: Domino precharged decoder
kinds.description: A dynamic-logic decoder that precharges every output node in one clock phase and lets only the selected line stay asserted in the evaluate phase, with its state held in the precharged output nodes and keeper devices.

kinds.name: Power-domain enable decoder
kinds.description: Decodes a domain identifier written by software into a one-hot request line for that domain's power switch, keeping a domain-select register and a request-pending flag.

kinds.name: Keypad row-drive decoder
kinds.description: Cycles a row counter and decodes it so one keypad row is driven low at a time while the columns are sampled, keeping the row counter and a per-row scan timer.

kinds.name: Gray-coded input decoder
kinds.description: Decodes a Gray-coded index directly into one-hot outputs, so that a single-bit input change moves the active line without intermediate glitches, keeping a registered copy of the Gray input.

kinds.name: Thermometer-to-binary encoder
kinds.description: Converts a thermometer-coded input vector into the binary count of its asserted lines, optionally latching the result in an output register.

kinds.name: Bubble-correcting flash ADC encoder
kinds.description: Cleans isolated bubble errors in a comparator thermometer code with local majority voting before encoding it to binary, holding the sampled comparator word and encoded output in registers.

kinds.name: One-hot-to-binary encoder with error flag
kinds.description: Encodes a one-hot input into its binary index and raises a registered error flag when zero or several lines are active, keeping the last index and error bit.

kinds.name: Hierarchical tree priority encoder
kinds.description: Splits a wide request vector into sub-blocks, encodes each locally, then selects the winning block in a second level and concatenates block and local indices, optionally registering per-level results.

kinds.name: Masked priority encoder
kinds.description: Encodes the highest-priority input among those enabled by a software-writable mask register, keeping the mask and the last encoded index.

kinds.name: Programmable-priority encoder
kinds.description: Selects the active input with the highest configurable priority level, storing a per-input priority-level register file and the winning index.

kinds.name: Threshold-gated priority encoder
kinds.description: Encodes the highest-priority active input only if its level exceeds a current-threshold register, holding the threshold and a pending index output.

kinds.name: Wraparound-search priority encoder
kinds.description: Searches the input vector starting from a programmable start-index register and wrapping around, reporting the first active line found and keeping the start index.

kinds.name: Bidirectional priority encoder
kinds.description: Simultaneously reports the indices of both the lowest and highest active input lines, optionally registering both indices and an any-active bit.

kinds.name: Top-two priority encoder
kinds.description: Finds the first and second highest-priority active inputs in one pass, holding both indices and their individual valid bits in output registers.

kinds.name: Iterative set-bit enumerator
kinds.description: Emits the indices of all active inputs one per cycle by repeatedly encoding and clearing the lowest set bit of a residual-mask register loaded from the input.

kinds.name: Serial scanning encoder
kinds.description: Polls input lines one at a time with a scan counter and stops when it finds an active line, keeping the scan counter, a found flag and the captured index.

kinds.name: Keypad matrix encoder
kinds.description: Drives rows of a key matrix in turn, samples columns, and encodes the pressed key's row and column into a key code, storing the row-scan counter, key-code register and key-pressed flag.

kinds.name: CAM match-line encoder
kinds.description: Converts the match lines of a content-addressable array into the address of the winning entry plus a multiple-hit indicator, latching the address and hit flags.

kinds.name: Field-granular priority encoder
kinds.description: Treats the input as a vector of multi-bit fields and encodes the index of the first nonzero field together with that field's value, keeping both in output registers.

kinds.name: Age-ordered priority encoder
kinds.description: Picks the active input that has waited longest, maintaining a per-input age counter that grows while the line stays active and resets on selection, plus the winner index.

kinds.name: First-arrival encoder
kinds.description: Records the index of whichever input became active first after re-arming, holding a winner-index register and a captured flag until cleared.

kinds.name: Most-recent-event encoder
kinds.description: Tracks the index of the most recently asserted input line by detecting rising edges against a previous-sample register and updating a last-event index register.

kinds.name: Change-detect encoder
kinds.description: Compares the inputs with a stored snapshot register and encodes the index of the highest-priority line that changed, along with its new value, then updates the snapshot.

kinds.name: Sticky latched priority encoder
kinds.description: Captures incoming active lines into a pending-latch register so short pulses are not lost, encodes the highest pending line, and clears that pending bit on acknowledge.

kinds.name: Comparator-bank level encoder
kinds.description: Compares an input sample against a bank of programmable threshold registers and encodes which interval the sample falls into as a binary bin index.

kinds.name: Combinatorial-number encoder
kinds.description: Encodes an input vector with exactly K active lines into its compact rank in the combinatorial number system, accumulating partial binomial sums in a rank register when computed sequentially.

kinds.name: NOR SR latch
kinds.description: Two cross-coupled NOR gates that set or reset on active-high S and R inputs and keep one stored bit, Q, in the feedback loop while both inputs are low.

kinds.name: Gated SR latch
kinds.description: An SR latch whose set and reset inputs pass only while an enable level is asserted, so it keeps its stored bit whenever the enable is inactive.

kinds.name: Gated D latch (active-high)
kinds.description: A transparent latch that passes D to Q while the enable is high and freezes the last value in its storage node when the enable falls.

kinds.name: Gated JK latch
kinds.description: A level-enabled latch whose J and K inputs set, reset or invert the stored bit while the enable is asserted, and it holds that bit otherwise.

kinds.name: Dynamic latch
kinds.description: A latch that samples data through a pass transistor onto a capacitive node and keeps the bit as stored charge only for a limited time after the enable closes.

kinds.name: Pulsed latch
kinds.description: A transparent latch opened by a narrow pulse generated from a clock edge, so it captures data in a short window and holds one bit between pulses.

kinds.name: Scan lockup latch
kinds.description: A latch placed between scan segments in different clock domains that holds the shifted bit for half a cycle to prevent hold races during scan shift.

kinds.name: LSSD shift-register latch
kinds.description: A level-sensitive scan design latch pair in which an L1 latch with separate system and scan clocks feeds an L2 latch, and each latch keeps one bit.

kinds.name: Dual-port latch
kinds.description: A latch with two independently enabled data inputs that each write one shared stored bit, which it holds when neither enable is active.

kinds.name: Tri-state output transparent latch
kinds.description: A multi-bit transparent latch bank with a latch-enable and an independent output-enable that holds a captured bus word and can release its outputs to high impedance.

kinds.name: State-retention balloon latch
kinds.description: An always-powered shadow latch that saves the bit of a power-gated register on a save signal, keeps it during power-down, and restores it on wake-up.

kinds.name: Razor shadow latch
kinds.description: A delayed-clock shadow latch beside a main storage element that recaptures late-arriving data and keeps that sampled bit for comparison with the main value.

kinds.name: Positive-edge D flip-flop
kinds.description: Captures the D input into its single state bit Q on each rising clock edge and holds it until the next rising edge.

kinds.name: JK flip-flop
kinds.description: Keeps one state bit that on each clock edge holds, sets, resets, or toggles according to the J and K inputs.

kinds.name: T flip-flop
kinds.description: Keeps one state bit that inverts on each clock edge when the T input is high and holds its value otherwise.

kinds.name: Clocked SR flip-flop
kinds.description: Keeps one state bit that is set by the S input or cleared by the R input, with changes taking effect only on the active clock edge.

kinds.name: Dual-edge-triggered flip-flop
kinds.description: Samples its D input into one stored output bit on both rising and falling clock edges, using two internal latches whose outputs are multiplexed by the clock level.

kinds.name: DICE radiation-hardened flip-flop
kinds.description: Stores one bit redundantly across four interlocked storage nodes so that a transient upset on a single node is restored by the others.

kinds.name: Event-clocked capture flip-flop
kinds.description: Uses an asynchronous event signal as its clock so that the rising edge of the event latches a one or a data bit into its single stored bit until reset.

kinds.name: Parallel-in serial-out shift register
kinds.description: Loads a full word in parallel and then shifts it out one bit per clock on a serial output, keeping the partly shifted word in its flip-flop chain.

kinds.name: Serial-in serial-out delay register
kinds.description: Passes a serial bit stream through a chain of flip-flops so that each bit comes out a fixed number of cycles later, keeping the in-transit bits as its state.

kinds.name: Circular rotate register
kinds.description: Rotates its stored word left or right by one position per enabled clock, feeding the bit that falls off one end back into the other, and keeps the current rotated word.

kinds.name: Byte-enable register
kinds.description: Stores a multi-byte word and updates only the bytes whose write-strobe bits are set during a write, keeping the other bytes unchanged.

kinds.name: Read-to-clear register
kinds.description: Accumulates event bits or a count in flip-flops and returns its contents on a bus read, resetting them as a side effect of that read.

kinds.name: Set/clear/toggle alias register
kinds.description: Exposes one stored word through separate set, clear and toggle write addresses, so individual bits can be changed atomically without a read-modify-write.

kinds.name: Tri-state bus register
kinds.description: Stores a word loaded from a shared bidirectional bus and drives it back onto the bus through tri-state buffers only while its output enable is active.

kinds.name: Ring counter
kinds.description: Circulates a single set bit through a closed loop of flip-flops, advancing one position per enabled clock, and stores the current token position as its state.

kinds.name: Lockable configuration register
kinds.description: Stores a configuration word together with a lock bit; once the lock is set, further writes to the word are ignored until reset.

kinds.name: Exchange register pair
kinds.description: Holds two words in separate registers that can each be loaded on their own or swapped with each other in a single clock cycle on a swap command.

kinds.name: Endian-swap register
kinds.description: Stores a multi-byte word and presents it on its output in either its natural or byte-reversed order, depending on an endianness control bit it also keeps.

kinds.name: Bypass register
kinds.description: Stores a word but can steer its input straight to its output through a bypass multiplexer when a bypass control is set, keeping the stored copy unchanged.

kinds.name: Hardware/software shared register
kinds.description: Keeps a word that can be written both by software over a bus and by internal hardware update logic, with a fixed priority choosing the winner when both write in the same cycle.

kinds.name: Self-clearing command register
kinds.description: Lets software write command bits that stay high for exactly one clock to start an action and then clear themselves automatically, storing only the pending pulse bits.

kinds.name: Bidirectional shift register
kinds.description: Shifts its contents left or right by one position per clock under a direction control, taking new bits from the left or right serial input, and keeps an N-bit data register.

kinds.name: Rotate-through-carry register
kinds.description: Rotates a data word one position per clock through an extra carry flip-flop that sits between the two ends, storing the N-bit word plus the carry bit.

kinds.name: Addressable tap shift register
kinds.description: Shifts serial data through a chain of stages and outputs the stage selected by a tap address to give a run-time programmable delay, keeping the stage chain and the tap-select register.

kinds.name: Fall-through shift FIFO
kinds.description: Queues words in a column of stage registers where each entry moves toward the output whenever the stage ahead is empty, keeping per-stage data registers and per-stage occupied flags.

kinds.name: Nonlinear feedback shift register
kinds.description: Shifts a register by one position per clock and feeds back a nonlinear Boolean function of selected taps into the input to generate sequences, holding the N-bit state register.

kinds.name: Double-data-rate shift register
kinds.description: Shifts in serial data on both rising and falling clock edges into two interleaved stage chains that are merged into a parallel word, keeping a rising-edge chain and a falling-edge chain.

kinds.name: Latched-output shift register
kinds.description: Shifts serial data into an internal shift stage and copies it to a separate output storage register on a latch strobe so outputs change only on update, keeping both the shift register and the storage latch register.

kinds.name: Bit-slip alignment register
kinds.description: Holds a window of incoming serial bits across two consecutive words and selects an output word at a slip offset that can be advanced one bit at a time to align word boundaries, keeping the window register and the slip-offset counter.

kinds.name: Sticky-bit right-shift register
kinds.description: Shifts a mantissa-style word right one position per clock while ORing every bit that falls off the low end into a sticky flip-flop, storing the data register and the sticky bit.

kinds.name: Sequential arithmetic shift register
kinds.description: Shifts a signed word right one position per clock while replicating the sign bit into the vacated top position, or left with zero fill, keeping an N-bit signed data register.

kinds.name: Thermometer-code shift register
kinds.description: Fills ones in from one end one position per clock on an increment and drains them from the same end on a decrement to represent a level as a thermometer code, keeping the N-bit thermometer register.

kinds.name: Pre-trigger capture shift register
kinds.description: Continuously shifts in samples of monitored signals and freezes on a trigger event so the history leading up to the trigger can be read out, keeping the sample chain and a frozen flag.

kinds.name: Majority-vote sample filter
kinds.description: Shifts the most recent N samples of a noisy input into a short register and drives a filtered output equal to the majority value of that window, keeping the sample window register and the registered output.

kinds.name: Bit-stuffing shift register
kinds.description: Shifts out a serial stream and inserts an extra zero after a run of consecutive ones, stalling the input while it does so, keeping the outgoing shift register and a run-length counter of recent ones.

kinds.name: Manchester-encoding shift register
kinds.description: Shifts out data bits one per bit period and expands each into a two-half-period transition pattern on the line, keeping the data shift register and a half-bit phase flip-flop.

kinds.name: Two-dimensional shift matrix
kinds.description: Arranges registers in a grid where the whole array shifts one row or one column per clock under a mode control, keeping an R-by-C array of stage registers.

kinds.name: Sentinel-bit word assembler
kinds.description: Preloads a single marker bit at one end of a register and shifts serial data in behind it so a complete word is recognized when the marker reaches the far end, keeping the shift register including the marker position and a word-ready flag.

kinds.name: Asynchronous ripple counter
kinds.description: A chain of toggle flip-flops in which each stage is clocked by the previous stage's output, so the count advances in binary with ripple delay; its state is the bank of toggle flip-flops.

kinds.name: Synchronous binary up counter
kinds.description: Increments a binary count register by one on every enabled clock edge, using a common clock and parallel carry logic; it keeps a single N-bit count register.

kinds.name: Up/down counter
kinds.description: Increments or decrements its count register on each enabled clock depending on a direction input; it keeps the count register and optionally a registered direction bit.

kinds.name: BCD decade counter
kinds.description: Steps a 4-bit register through decimal digits 0 to 9 and emits a carry when it rolls over to 0; it keeps one 4-bit BCD digit register.

kinds.name: Presettable loadable counter
kinds.description: Counts normally but can be loaded in parallel with an arbitrary value from an input bus on a load strobe; it keeps a count register.

kinds.name: Pipelined split counter
kinds.description: Divides a wide counter into a low and a high segment with a registered carry between them so the high segment increments one cycle after the low segment wraps, enabling high clock rates; it keeps the low segment, the high segment and a carry pipeline flop.

kinds.name: Dual-modulus prescaler
kinds.description: Divides an input pulse stream by either P or P+1 as selected by a mode control, used in front of slower counters; it keeps a small internal state counter and the registered mode select.

kinds.name: Pulse-swallow counter
kinds.description: Combines a dual-modulus prescaler with a program counter and a swallow counter to realize an overall division ratio of N times P plus S; it keeps the program count register and the swallow count register.

kinds.name: Mixed-radix counter
kinds.description: Advances a set of digits in which each digit has its own modulus (for example 60, 60, 24), carrying into the next digit on wraparound; it keeps one count register per digit.

kinds.name: Wrapping counter with sticky overflow
kinds.description: Increments freely and wraps on reaching its maximum, setting a sticky overflow flag that stays set until software clears it; it keeps a count register and an overflow flag bit.

kinds.name: Arbitrary-sequence counter
kinds.description: Steps through a user-defined non-binary sequence of codes by looking up each next state in a small table indexed by the current state; it keeps a state register and a next-state lookup memory.

kinds.name: Half adder
kinds.description: Adds two single bits to produce a sum bit and a carry-out bit, purely combinationally with no stored state.

kinds.name: Full adder
kinds.description: Adds two operand bits plus a carry-in to produce a sum bit and a carry-out bit, combinationally with no registers.

kinds.name: Half subtractor
kinds.description: Subtracts one bit from another, producing a difference bit and a borrow-out bit, with no internal state.

kinds.name: Full subtractor
kinds.description: Subtracts a subtrahend bit and a borrow-in from a minuend bit, producing a difference and borrow-out, with no stored state.

kinds.name: Carry-skip adder
kinds.description: Splits a ripple chain into blocks whose group-propagate signals let the carry bypass whole blocks, holding no registers.

kinds.name: Conditional-sum adder
kinds.description: Recursively computes sums for both possible carry-ins at every level and selects with multiplexers as carries resolve, keeping no state.

kinds.name: Sklansky prefix adder
kinds.description: Computes carries with a divide-and-conquer parallel-prefix tree of minimal depth and high fan-out, purely combinationally.

kinds.name: Han-Carlson adder
kinds.description: Uses a hybrid prefix network that computes odd-bit carries in a sparse Kogge-Stone tree and fills even bits in a final stage, with no registers.

kinds.name: Ladner-Fischer adder
kinds.description: Builds its carry network from a parallel-prefix structure trading depth against fan-out between Sklansky and Brent-Kung styles, with no stored state.

kinds.name: Knowles adder
kinds.description: Uses a parallel-prefix carry tree with configurable fan-out per level to balance wiring and logic depth, holding no state.

kinds.name: Ling adder
kinds.description: Computes a simplified pseudo-carry signal in its lookahead logic and recovers true sums at the end to shorten the critical path, without registers.

kinds.name: Sparse-tree adder
kinds.description: Generates only every k-th carry with a prefix tree and feeds them to small carry-select blocks that form the sums, keeping no state.

kinds.name: Carry-increment adder
kinds.description: Computes each block's sum assuming zero carry-in and then conditionally increments it when the incoming block carry arrives, with no registers.

kinds.name: Manchester carry-chain adder
kinds.description: Propagates carries along a chain of pass-transistor switches controlled by per-bit propagate, generate and kill signals, with dynamic precharge nodes but no clocked registers.

kinds.name: Adder-subtractor
kinds.description: Adds or subtracts two operands under a mode control by XOR-inverting the second operand and feeding the mode bit as carry-in, also flagging carry and overflow, with no stored state.

kinds.name: Pipelined adder
kinds.description: Breaks a wide carry chain into segments separated by pipeline registers that hold partial sums, operand slices and inter-segment carries.

kinds.name: 4:2 compressor
kinds.description: Reduces four operand bits plus a carry-in to a sum bit, a carry bit and a lateral carry-out for multi-operand addition, with no stored state.

kinds.name: Multi-operand adder tree
kinds.description: Sums many input words at once through a tree of two-input or compressor adders ending in a carry-propagate adder, optionally with pipeline registers between levels.

kinds.name: Incrementer
kinds.description: Adds one to an input word using a half-adder chain or prefix AND tree to form the carries, with no internal state.

kinds.name: Decrementer
kinds.description: Subtracts one from an input word by propagating a borrow through trailing zeros, with no internal registers.

kinds.name: End-around-carry adder
kinds.description: Adds two one's-complement operands and feeds the carry-out back into the least-significant carry-in, holding no state.

kinds.name: Signed-digit redundant adder
kinds.description: Adds two numbers in redundant signed-digit representation with carry propagation limited to adjacent digits, producing a redundant result without registers.

kinds.name: Excess-3 adder
kinds.description: Adds two excess-3 coded decimal digits using a binary adder and a correction stage that adds or subtracts three, with no stored state.

kinds.name: Sum-of-absolute-differences unit
kinds.description: Computes absolute differences of paired operand elements with subtractors and conditional negation and sums them, holding an accumulator register for the running total.

kinds.name: Dadda tree multiplier
kinds.description: Reduces the partial-product matrix with the minimum number of full and half adders at each column height stage, then uses a final carry-propagate adder; it keeps registered input operands and a registered product output.

kinds.name: Baugh-Wooley multiplier
kinds.description: Multiplies two's-complement operands in an array by inverting selected partial-product bits and adding correction constants so no sign extension is needed; it keeps operand input registers and a product output register.

kinds.name: Radix-8 Booth multiplier
kinds.description: Recodes the multiplier into overlapping 4-bit groups that select multiples from minus four to plus four times the multiplicand, so it generates one-third as many partial products; it keeps a precomputed triple-multiplicand register and pipeline registers between the recoding, reduction and final-add stages.

kinds.name: Serial-parallel multiplier
kinds.description: Takes one multiplier bit per clock against a parallel multiplicand and shifts the product out serially through a chain of carry-save adder cells; it keeps the parallel multiplicand register, per-cell sum and carry flops, and a bit counter.

kinds.name: Karatsuba multiplier
kinds.description: Splits each operand into high and low halves and forms the product from three half-width multiplications plus additions and subtractions; it keeps registers for the three sub-products and the recombined output.

kinds.name: Toom-Cook multiplier
kinds.description: Splits operands into k limbs, evaluates them as polynomials at several points, multiplies the evaluations pointwise and interpolates the result; it keeps evaluation-point registers, pointwise-product registers and an interpolation accumulator.

kinds.name: Constant-coefficient CSD multiplier
kinds.description: Multiplies an input by a fixed constant using hardwired shifts and add/subtract operations derived from the constant's canonical-signed-digit form; it keeps an input register and an output product register.

kinds.name: Multiple-constant multiplier block
kinds.description: Computes the products of one input with a set of fixed coefficients through a shared shift-add graph that reuses intermediate terms; it keeps the input register and one output register per coefficient.

kinds.name: Squarer unit
kinds.description: Computes the square of a single operand using a folded partial-product array that merges symmetric terms to roughly halve the adder count; it keeps an operand register and a result register.

kinds.name: Carry-save iterative multiplier
kinds.description: Adds one partial product per cycle into a redundant sum/carry accumulator and runs a carry-propagate addition only at the end; it keeps sum and carry accumulator registers, a multiplier shift register and a step counter.

kinds.name: Mitchell logarithmic multiplier
kinds.description: Approximates a product by finding each operand's leading-one position, adding the approximated logarithms and taking an approximate antilogarithm; it keeps registers for the leading-one positions, the fractional mantissas and the approximate product.

kinds.name: Truncated fixed-width multiplier
kinds.description: Produces only the upper half of the product by omitting low-order partial-product columns and adding a compensation bias; it keeps operand registers and an n-bit result register.

kinds.name: Complex multiplier
kinds.description: Multiplies two complex numbers using three real multiplications and five additions in the Gauss arrangement; it keeps registers for the real and imaginary inputs, the intermediate products and the complex result.

kinds.name: Distributed-arithmetic multiplier
kinds.description: Computes a sum of products with fixed coefficients by using the input bits, one bit position per cycle, to address a precomputed table and shift-accumulating the outputs; it keeps the coefficient-sum ROM, input shift registers, an accumulator and a bit counter.

kinds.name: Quarter-square LUT multiplier
kinds.description: Forms a product as the difference of looked-up quarter-squares of the operand sum and difference; it keeps the quarter-square lookup ROM, sum and difference registers and a product register.

kinds.name: SIMD partitioned multiplier
kinds.description: Can be configured to perform one full-width multiply or several independent narrower lane multiplies by breaking carry and partial-product paths at lane boundaries; it keeps a mode register, operand registers and a lane-packed result register.

kinds.name: Vedic Urdhva multiplier
kinds.description: Generates all vertical and crosswise partial products of the operand digits in parallel and sums them column by column with carries, following the Urdhva-Tiryagbhyam scheme; it keeps operand registers and a result register.

kinds.name: Stochastic bitstream multiplier
kinds.description: Multiplies two probabilities encoded as random bitstreams by ANDing them bit by bit and counting the ones in the output stream; it keeps two stream-generator state registers, an output ones counter and a stream-length counter.

kinds.name: RNS channel multiplier
kinds.description: Multiplies operands held as residues modulo a set of co-prime moduli, with one independent modular multiplier per channel; it keeps per-channel residue input registers and per-channel residue product registers.

kinds.name: Systolic linear-array multiplier
kinds.description: Pipes multiplier bits through a one-dimensional chain of identical cells, each holding one multiplicand bit and adding into a passing partial sum; it keeps per-cell multiplicand bit, partial-sum, carry and control-token flops.

kinds.name: Tiled multi-precision multiplier
kinds.description: Builds a wide product by scheduling narrower hardware multiplies over operand limb pairs and accumulating them at the correct shifted offsets; it keeps limb index counters, operand limb buffers and a wide multi-word accumulator.

kinds.name: Interleaved modular multiplier
kinds.description: Computes A times B mod N by scanning B bit by bit, doubling and conditionally adding A to a partial result, then subtracting N when the partial result reaches or exceeds N; it keeps the A, B and modulus registers, a partial-result register and a bit counter.

kinds.name: Goldschmidt divider
kinds.description: Iteratively multiplies the dividend and divisor by the same correction factor until the divisor approaches one, keeping numerator, denominator, correction-factor and iteration-count registers.

kinds.name: Constant reciprocal-multiply divider
kinds.description: Divides by a fixed or preloaded divisor by multiplying with a stored magic reciprocal and shifting, holding the magic constant, shift amount and pipelined product registers.

kinds.name: Bit-serial divider
kinds.description: Computes a quotient from serially arriving operand bits using a one-bit subtractor per cycle, keeping a partial-remainder shift register, divisor register, borrow flip-flop and bit counter.

kinds.name: Combinational array divider
kinds.description: Computes quotient and remainder in a single combinational pass through rows of controlled subtract cells, with only optional input and output operand registers.

kinds.name: Pipelined unrolled divider
kinds.description: Spreads the digit-recurrence steps across pipeline stages so a new division can start every cycle, keeping per-stage partial-remainder, divisor, quotient-bits and valid registers.

kinds.name: Online MSB-first divider
kinds.description: Produces signed-digit quotient digits most-significant first after a small online delay as operand digits stream in, keeping redundant residual, accumulated operand and digit-position registers.

kinds.name: Modulo-by-constant reducer
kinds.description: Computes the remainder of a wide input modulo a fixed constant by folding chunks with precomputed weights, keeping a folded-residue accumulator and chunk index register.

kinds.name: Divide-by-three FSM
kinds.description: Computes the quotient and remainder of a serial binary stream divided by three using a small remainder-state register that also emits quotient bits into an output shift register.

kinds.name: Barrett reduction unit
kinds.description: Reduces a product modulo a fixed modulus by estimating the quotient with a precomputed scaled reciprocal and applying final correction subtractions, keeping modulus, reciprocal, quotient-estimate and residue registers.

kinds.name: GF(2) polynomial divider
kinds.description: Performs polynomial long division over GF(2) by XOR-shifting the divisor polynomial into the dividend, keeping a remainder register, divisor polynomial register, quotient shift register and degree counter.

kinds.name: Binary-field divider
kinds.description: Computes a/b in GF(2^m) using a binary extended-Euclid style iteration, keeping four polynomial registers for the working pairs, degree-difference register and iteration control state.

kinds.name: BCD decimal divider
kinds.description: Divides packed-BCD operands digit by digit using repeated decimal subtraction with multiples of the divisor, keeping a decimal partial-remainder, divisor-multiple table, quotient-digit and digit-position registers.

kinds.name: Early-termination normalizing divider
kinds.description: Normalizes operands with leading-zero counts to skip unnecessary iterations and finishes in a variable number of cycles, keeping shift-amount, partial-remainder, quotient, remaining-iterations and done registers.

kinds.name: Signed division wrapper
kinds.description: Wraps an unsigned divide core with operand absolute-value conversion, sign recording, and quotient/remainder sign fix-up, keeping saved sign flags, divide-by-zero and overflow status registers.

kinds.name: Repeated-subtraction divider
kinds.description: Subtracts the divisor from the dividend once per cycle while incrementing a quotient counter, keeping a running-remainder register, divisor register and quotient counter.

kinds.name: Combined divide/square-root unit
kinds.description: Shares one digit-recurrence datapath for both division and square root, selecting the operation per request and keeping operation-mode, partial-remainder, root/quotient, divisor and iteration registers.

kinds.name: Prescaled digit-recurrence divider
kinds.description: Scales the divisor and dividend by a table-derived factor so quotient digits can be selected by simple rounding of the residual, keeping scale-factor, scaled-operand, residual and quotient registers.

kinds.name: Exact divider
kinds.description: Computes the quotient when the divisor is known to divide the dividend evenly using LSB-first modular-inverse multiplication, keeping the divisor inverse, working dividend and quotient shift registers.

kinds.name: Modular inverse unit
kinds.description: Computes the inverse of a value modulo an odd modulus using a binary extended-Euclidean iteration, keeping u, v, x1, x2 working registers, the modulus and a busy flag.

kinds.name: Mitchell logarithmic approximate divider
kinds.description: Approximates a quotient by converting operands to piecewise-linear logarithms, subtracting them and taking the antilogarithm, keeping leading-one position, mantissa-fraction and result registers.

kinds.name: Multi-word long divider
kinds.description: Divides multi-precision integers word by word with normalized quotient-digit estimation and add-back correction, keeping a scratch memory for the remainder words, divisor words, quotient words and word-index counters.

kinds.name: SIMD partitioned divider
kinds.description: Performs several independent narrow divisions in parallel lanes of one wide iterative datapath, keeping per-lane partial-remainder, divisor and quotient fields plus a lane-width mode register.

kinds.name: Table-lookup reciprocal approximation unit
kinds.description: Produces a low-precision reciprocal seed from a ROM indexed by leading divisor bits plus a linear interpolation term, keeping the ROM table, index register and interpolated output register.

kinds.name: Window comparator
kinds.description: Reports whether an input value lies between a lower and an upper bound, holding both bounds in programmable registers and latching the in-range result in an output flag register.

kinds.name: Hysteresis threshold comparator
kinds.description: Compares an input against separate rising and falling thresholds so the output changes only on a decisive crossing, keeping both threshold registers and a registered output-state bit.

kinds.name: MSB-first serial comparator
kinds.description: Compares two operands one bit per clock starting from the most significant bit, keeping a small decided/less-than/greater-than state register that freezes once the first differing bit is seen.

kinds.name: LSB-first serial comparator
kinds.description: Compares two operands one bit per clock starting from the least significant bit, overwriting a running relation register whenever the current bit pair differs so the final value reflects the most significant difference.

kinds.name: Mode-selectable signed/unsigned comparator
kinds.description: Produces less-than, equal and greater-than flags for two operands under either two's-complement or unsigned interpretation, with a mode register selecting the interpretation and a registered flag output.

kinds.name: Masked equality comparator
kinds.description: Tests two words for equality only on bit positions enabled by a programmable mask, storing the mask and reference pattern in registers and latching a match flag.

kinds.name: Min/max selector
kinds.description: Routes the smaller and the larger of two inputs to separate outputs using a single magnitude decision, holding the selected results in output registers.

kinds.name: Threshold crossing detector
kinds.description: Flags when a sampled signal crosses a programmed level and indicates the direction of the crossing, keeping the threshold register, the previous-sample register, and a crossing-event flag.

kinds.name: Hamming-distance threshold comparator
kinds.description: Counts the bit positions in which two words differ and compares that count to a programmable tolerance, holding the tolerance register and a registered near-match flag.

kinds.name: Memory-protection region checker
kinds.description: Compares an access address against several base/limit region pairs to decide whether it falls inside a permitted region, storing per-region base, limit and permission registers plus a registered fault flag.

kinds.name: Wraparound sequence-number comparator
kinds.description: Decides whether one modular sequence number is ahead of another using half-range serial-number arithmetic, holding a reference sequence register and a registered newer/older/equal result.

kinds.name: Tolerance comparator
kinds.description: Reports approximate equality when the absolute difference of two values does not exceed a programmable epsilon, storing the epsilon register and a registered within-tolerance flag.

kinds.name: Fraction cross-multiply comparator
kinds.description: Orders two ratios a/b and c/d by comparing the products a*d and c*b without performing division, holding the two product registers and a registered relation result.

kinds.name: Gray-code magnitude comparator
kinds.description: Determines the ordering of two Gray-coded values directly by scanning bits with a running parity that tracks inversion, keeping a registered relation output and no binary conversion stage.

kinds.name: Carry-save sum-equality checker
kinds.description: Tests whether the sum of two operands equals a target value without a carry-propagating addition, using per-bit carry prediction logic, with the target held in a register and a latched equality flag.

kinds.name: Pipelined wide comparator
kinds.description: Splits a very wide comparison into chunks evaluated in parallel and merged over several pipeline stages, keeping per-stage registers of partial equal/greater results and a valid bit per stage.

kinds.name: Sign-magnitude comparator
kinds.description: Orders two sign-magnitude encoded numbers by handling the sign bits and then comparing magnitudes with order reversed for negatives, treating the two zero encodings as equal and registering the result.

kinds.name: Vector predicate comparator
kinds.description: Compares corresponding lanes of two packed vectors in parallel under a selected relation code and writes one result bit per lane into a predicate mask register, keeping the relation-select register as well.

kinds.name: FIFO watermark comparator
kinds.description: Compares a queue's fill level against programmable almost-full and almost-empty thresholds, storing both threshold registers and registered watermark status flags.

kinds.name: SIMD packed ALU
kinds.description: Performs one selected add, subtract or logic operation in parallel on byte, halfword or word lanes of a wide operand, breaking carries at lane boundaries per a lane-size control; it keeps a result register and a per-lane flag vector register.

kinds.name: Accumulator-based ALU
kinds.description: Combines an incoming operand with an internal accumulator using a selected operation such as add, subtract, AND, OR or XOR and writes the result back; it keeps the accumulator register and a status register of carry, zero, negative and overflow flags.

kinds.name: Boolean function unit
kinds.description: Computes any of the sixteen two-input bitwise logic functions on two operands, choosing the function with a 4-bit truth-table code; it keeps a registered result and a zero flag.

kinds.name: Bit-field extract/insert unit
kinds.description: Extracts a field of given start position and width from a source word with zero or sign extension, or inserts a field into a destination word; it keeps position and width control registers and a result register.

kinds.name: Rotate-and-mask unit
kinds.description: Rotates an operand by a shift amount and then ANDs it with a mask generated from begin and end bit indices, optionally merging it into a destination; it keeps the mask-bounds registers and the result register.

kinds.name: Clamp unit
kinds.description: Bounds an input value between programmable lower and upper limits, outputting the limit when exceeded; it keeps the lower-limit, upper-limit and result registers plus a clipped status flag.

kinds.name: Conditional-select unit
kinds.description: Chooses between two operands based on a condition code evaluated against the current flags, implementing conditional move and select instructions; it keeps the selected result register.

kinds.name: Condition-code evaluator
kinds.description: Decodes a condition field such as equal, less-than or carry-set against stored N, Z, C and V flags to produce a single taken or true signal; it keeps the flags register that ALU operations update.

kinds.name: Address generation unit
kinds.description: Computes effective addresses as base plus scaled index plus displacement with optional base writeback for auto-increment modes; it keeps the computed address register and an alignment-fault flag.

kinds.name: Multi-precision add-with-carry unit
kinds.description: Adds or subtracts word-sized limbs of large integers over successive operations using the carry or borrow from the previous limb; it keeps the carry flag register between operations and a per-limb result register.

kinds.name: Byte-permute unit
kinds.description: Rearranges the bytes of one or two source words according to a selector vector to implement byte swap, broadcast and shuffle operations; it keeps the selector register and the permuted result register.

kinds.name: Increment/decrement unit
kinds.description: Adds or subtracts one or a small constant step from an operand with fast carry handling and produces zero and wrap flags; it keeps the result register and the flag bits.

kinds.name: Single-bit manipulation unit
kinds.description: Sets, clears, inverts or tests one bit of an operand selected by an index operand, producing the modified word and the tested bit as a flag; it keeps the result register and the test flag.

kinds.name: Halving average unit
kinds.description: Adds two operands with one extra bit of precision and shifts right by one, with selectable round-up or truncation, per lane; it keeps the averaged result register.

kinds.name: Residue number system ALU
kinds.description: Performs addition, subtraction and multiplication independently in several small moduli channels with no carry between them; it keeps one residue register per modulus channel.

kinds.name: Stochastic computing ALU
kinds.description: Operates on random bitstreams whose density encodes values, using AND gates for multiplication and multiplexers for scaled addition, then counts output ones to recover a result; it keeps the output ones counter and a stream-length counter.

kinds.name: Bit-serial ALU
kinds.description: Executes add, subtract and logic operations one bit per clock on operands shifted in least-significant bit first, using a selected one-bit function; it keeps the operand and result shift registers and a carry flop.

kinds.name: Vector reduction ALU
kinds.description: Combines all elements of a vector into one scalar by repeated application of a selected operation such as sum, min, max, AND or OR over multiple cycles; it keeps the partial-result register and an element index counter.

kinds.name: Pipelined barrel shifter
kinds.description: Splits the shift stages across several clock stages for high frequency, and keeps the pipeline registers holding partially shifted data, remaining amount bits and a valid bit per stage.

kinds.name: Crossbar shifter
kinds.description: Decodes the shift amount to one-hot and drives an N-by-N switch matrix so every output bit selects its source in one level, with a registered one-hot select vector and output word.

kinds.name: Bitfield extract unit
kinds.description: Right-shifts a source to bring a field of given offset and length to bit zero, then zero- or sign-fills the upper bits, and holds the offset, length and extracted-field registers.

kinds.name: Bitfield insert unit
kinds.description: Left-shifts a field to a given offset and merges it into a destination word under a generated mask, keeping the destination, field, offset and length registers.

kinds.name: Shifter operand unit with carry-out
kinds.description: Applies LSL, LSR, ASR or ROR by an immediate or register amount to an ALU operand and produces the last bit shifted out, keeping a registered shifted operand and shifter carry-out flag.

kinds.name: Floating-point alignment shifter
kinds.description: Right-shifts the smaller significand by the exponent difference and ORs all shifted-out bits into guard, round and sticky bits, holding the aligned significand and the GRS register.

kinds.name: Rounding right shifter
kinds.description: Shifts a fixed-point value right by a variable amount and adds a rounding increment derived from the dropped bits, keeping the shifted value and a registered rounding-mode setting.

kinds.name: Saturating left shifter
kinds.description: Shifts a signed value left by a variable amount and clamps to the most positive or negative value when significant bits would be lost, keeping the result register and a sticky saturation flag.

kinds.name: Overrange-clamping shifter
kinds.description: Treats shift amounts at or beyond the word width specially by forcing zero or sign-fill output instead of wrapping the count, and keeps the result plus an out-of-range indicator register.

kinds.name: SIMD lane-partitioned shifter
kinds.description: Shifts or rotates a wide word as independent 8-, 16- or 32-bit lanes by breaking cross-lane paths according to a lane-size setting, and holds the lane-mode register and per-lane results.

kinds.name: Byte-lane load aligner
kinds.description: Rotates a fetched memory word by the low address bits so the addressed byte, halfword or word lands at bit zero, then zero- or sign-extends it, holding the address offset and size registers and the aligned result.

kinds.name: Store data steering rotator
kinds.description: Rotates store data up to the byte position given by the address offset and generates matching byte-enable strobes, keeping registered aligned data and the byte-enable vector.

kinds.name: Stream byte realigner
kinds.description: Shifts incoming bus beats by a byte offset so a misaligned stream comes out aligned, carrying the leftover bytes of each beat in a residue register along with the current offset register.

kinds.name: Wide segmented shifter
kinds.description: Shifts a multi-word value by splitting it into segments that each shift locally and pass spill-over bits to their neighbor, keeping per-segment registers and the inter-segment spill registers.

kinds.name: QC-LDPC circulant shifter
kinds.description: Cyclically rotates a block of Z soft values by a per-entry shift taken from a parity-check base matrix for a configurable lifting size, keeping the lifting-size register, the shift-value ROM and the rotated block register.

kinds.name: Fixed multi-rotation XOR network
kinds.description: Computes the XOR of several constant-amount rotations and shifts of a word, as in hash sigma functions, in one cycle, and keeps only the input and output word registers.
