kinds.name: Vector element slide unit
kinds.description: Moves whole elements of a vector register up or down by a scalar offset, filling vacated positions from a scalar or leaving them unchanged, and holds the offset register and destination element buffer.

kinds.name: Inverse-butterfly rotator
kinds.description: Implements arbitrary rotation through a log-depth inverse butterfly network whose per-stage swap controls are computed from the rotate amount, keeping the control-bit register and output register.

kinds.name: Fused multiply-add unit
kinds.description: Computes a*b+c with a single final rounding, keeping pipeline registers for the unrounded product, aligned addend, wide intermediate sum and the result sign and exponent.

kinds.name: Leading-zero anticipator
kinds.description: Predicts the normalization shift amount in parallel with mantissa addition from the two aligned operands, holding a registered indicator string and predicted shift count.

kinds.name: Exponent compare and operand swap unit
kinds.description: Subtracts the operand exponents, swaps the operands so the larger magnitude comes first, and registers the swapped significands, exponent difference and swap flag.

kinds.name: Near/far path adder selector
kinds.description: Routes a floating-point add to either a close path for small exponent differences with cancellation or a far path for large shifts, keeping both path result registers and a path-select bit.

kinds.name: Floating-point classify unit
kinds.description: Examines a value's sign, exponent and fraction fields and outputs a registered category mask marking zero, subnormal, normal, infinity, signaling NaN or quiet NaN with sign.

kinds.name: NaN propagation and canonicalization unit
kinds.description: Selects which input NaN, if any, propagates to the result, quiets signaling NaNs or replaces them with a canonical NaN, and registers the chosen payload and an invalid indication.

kinds.name: Floating-point min/max unit
kinds.description: Returns the minimum or maximum of two operands with IEEE handling of signed zeros and NaNs, keeping a registered result and invalid-operation flag.

kinds.name: Sign-injection unit
kinds.description: Builds a result from one operand's magnitude and a sign taken, inverted or XORed from another operand, holding the output value in a result register.

kinds.name: Precision format converter
kinds.description: Converts between floating-point formats such as double, single, half and bfloat16 by rebiasing the exponent and rounding or extending the significand, storing the converted value and overflow, underflow and inexact flags.

kinds.name: Round-to-integral unit
kinds.description: Rounds a floating-point value to an integer-valued floating-point number under a selected rounding mode, holding the masked significand, increment bit and inexact flag in pipeline registers.

kinds.name: Exponent scaling unit
kinds.description: Adds a signed integer to a value's exponent to implement scaleB/ldexp with overflow and gradual-underflow handling, registering the adjusted exponent, shifted significand and status flags.

kinds.name: Rounding mode control register
kinds.description: Holds the dynamic rounding-mode field and per-instruction override decode, supplying the effective rounding mode to the arithmetic pipelines from a small configuration register.

kinds.name: Underflow tininess detector
kinds.description: Determines whether a result is tiny before or after rounding by evaluating the unbounded-exponent result, keeping registered tininess, exactness and underflow-flag outputs.

kinds.name: Stochastic rounding unit
kinds.description: Rounds a significand up or down with probability proportional to the discarded fraction by comparing those bits against a random value, keeping a pseudorandom state register and a rounded-output register.

kinds.name: Goldschmidt divide/square-root unit
kinds.description: Iteratively multiplies numerator and denominator by convergence factors to compute quotients or square roots, keeping numerator, denominator and factor registers plus an iteration counter.

kinds.name: Reciprocal square-root estimate unit
kinds.description: Produces a low-precision 1/sqrt(x) seed from a lookup table indexed by exponent parity and leading significand bits, storing the table ROM and a registered estimate.

kinds.name: Floating-point log2 approximation unit
kinds.description: Computes log2 of a floating-point input by taking the unbiased exponent as the integer part and a table-plus-polynomial evaluation of the significand, holding coefficient ROM and partial-result pipeline registers.

kinds.name: Floating-point exp2 unit
kinds.description: Computes 2^x by splitting x into integer and fractional parts, evaluating the fractional power from a table and polynomial, and placing the integer part into the exponent, with coefficient ROM and staged registers.

kinds.name: Horner polynomial evaluator
kinds.description: Evaluates a polynomial approximation of a transcendental function by repeated fused multiply-adds, keeping a coefficient memory, a running accumulator register and a degree counter.

kinds.name: Kulisch exact accumulator
kinds.description: Accumulates floating-point products exactly into a very wide fixed-point register spanning the full exponent range, keeping that long accumulator and a final round-to-float output register.

kinds.name: Interleaved floating-point accumulator
kinds.description: Hides adder latency by rotating additions across several partial-sum registers selected by a slot counter and reducing them into one sum at the end of a sequence.

kinds.name: Packed SIMD floating-point adder
kinds.description: Performs several narrow-precision floating-point additions in parallel by splitting a wide datapath into lanes, keeping per-lane exponent, significand and flag registers plus a lane-mode configuration register.

kinds.name: Traffic light controller
kinds.description: Cycles an intersection through green, yellow and red phases for each road, holding the current phase in a state register and a dwell timer counting down the time remaining in that phase.

kinds.name: Vending machine controller
kinds.description: Accepts coin inputs, tracks deposited value in a credit register and the transaction step in a state register, and issues vend and change-return outputs when a selection is made.

kinds.name: Elevator controller
kinds.description: Moves a car between floors by serving pending calls, keeping a current-floor register, a direction bit, a pending-request bit vector and a door-state register.

kinds.name: Combination lock FSM
kinds.description: Compares keypad digits against a stored code one at a time, holding a digit-position register, a failed-attempt counter and a lockout timer.

kinds.name: Exponential backoff controller
kinds.description: Schedules retransmission after collisions in a shared-medium protocol, holding a collision-attempt counter, a randomly loaded backoff slot counter and a waiting/transmitting state.

kinds.name: Link training state machine
kinds.description: Steps a serial link through detect, polling, configuration and active states, keeping a state register, a timeout counter and a count of consecutive training sequences received.

kinds.name: Multi-rail power-up sequencer
kinds.description: Enables supply rails in a fixed order with delays and power-good checks, holding a step-index register, an inter-step delay counter and a fault state.

kinds.name: DRAM initialization sequencer
kinds.description: Issues the power-up command sequence (reset, clock-enable, mode-register writes, ZQ calibration) to a memory device, keeping a command-index register and a wait-cycle counter.

kinds.name: PLL lock detector
kinds.description: Declares a clock loop locked or unlocked by watching phase-error samples, keeping a lock state bit and a counter of consecutive in-window samples.

kinds.name: Frame delineation synchronizer
kinds.description: Finds frame boundaries in a serial stream by moving through hunt, presync and sync states, holding the state register plus counters of consecutive good and bad frame headers.

kinds.name: Ethernet auto-negotiation arbiter
kinds.description: Exchanges capability pages with a link partner and selects a common operating mode, keeping a negotiation state register, a link timer and a received-abilities register.

kinds.name: I2C bus recovery FSM
kinds.description: Frees a stuck I2C bus by toggling the clock line until the data line is released and then issuing a stop, holding a pulse counter and a recovery-phase state register.

kinds.name: Transaction retry controller
kinds.description: Reissues a failed bus or network request up to a limit, keeping an outstanding-request state, a retry counter and a response-timeout timer.

kinds.name: Token ring station controller
kinds.description: Captures, holds and forwards a circulating token on a ring network, keeping a token-held flag, a token-hold timer and a transmit/repeat state register.

kinds.name: Battery charge controller
kinds.description: Moves a charger through precharge, constant-current, constant-voltage and done phases based on measured voltage and current, keeping a phase register and a safety timer.

kinds.name: Appliance cycle sequencer
kinds.description: Runs a timed program of steps such as fill, wash, drain and spin, holding a program-step register, a step timer and a paused flag.

kinds.name: Startup calibration sequencer
kinds.description: Steps an analog block through trim codes and compares measurements at each step to pick the best setting, keeping a step register, a candidate trim register and a best-result register.

kinds.name: LED pattern sequencer
kinds.description: Plays a stored sequence of light patterns, holding a pattern-index register, a dwell counter for the current pattern and a loop-mode flag.

kinds.name: Morse code decoder
kinds.description: Classifies on/off durations into dots, dashes and gaps and assembles characters, keeping a duration counter, a symbol shift register and a symbol-count register.

kinds.name: Serial two's-complementer
kinds.description: A Mealy machine that negates a number fed in least-significant bit first by passing bits through until the first one and then inverting, holding a single seen-first-one state bit.

kinds.name: Serial divisibility-by-3 checker
kinds.description: Reads a binary number most-significant bit first and reports whether the value so far is a multiple of three, holding a two-bit remainder state register.

kinds.name: Banked register file
kinds.description: Splits the architectural registers across several single- or dual-ported SRAM banks selected by register-index bits, holding the register values in per-bank arrays plus a bank-conflict detect register for the current cycle.

kinds.name: Windowed register file
kinds.description: Exposes a sliding window of in, local and out registers over a large circular physical array, keeping the register contents together with a current-window-pointer and a window-invalid mask used to trigger spill and fill traps.

kinds.name: Rotating register file
kinds.description: Renames a region of registers by adding a rotating register base to each index on every loop iteration for software pipelining, storing the register array and the rotating base offset.

kinds.name: Unified physical register file
kinds.description: Holds all speculative and committed values of an out-of-order core in a large multi-ported array indexed by physical tag, along with a per-entry ready bit read by the wakeup logic.

kinds.name: Vector register file
kinds.description: Stores wide vector registers sliced into lanes, each lane with its own read and write ports feeding a vector ALU lane, plus per-register element-length configuration state.

kinds.name: Matrix tile register file
kinds.description: Holds two-dimensional tiles of rows by columns accessed row-wise for loads and stores and as whole operands by a matrix engine, keeping the tile data and a per-tile shape configuration register.

kinds.name: Mode-banked shadow register file
kinds.description: Provides duplicate copies of selected registers for privileged or fast-interrupt modes, switching the visible copy on mode change, and keeps both the shared and mode-private register arrays plus the current mode field.

kinds.name: Operand-collector register file
kinds.description: Serves a GPU's many warps from single-ported banks by buffering requested operands in collector units until all sources arrive, keeping the banked register array, collector entry buffers and per-operand valid bits.

kinds.name: Register file cache
kinds.description: Places a small, heavily ported cache of recently written or soon-to-be-read values in front of a large main register file, storing cached values with their register tags and replacement state.

kinds.name: Replicated register file
kinds.description: Achieves many read ports by keeping several identical copies of the register array, each with a subset of the read ports, all receiving every write.

kinds.name: Live-value-table register file
kinds.description: Builds a multi-write-port memory from one bank per write port and a small live-value table recording which bank last wrote each address, used to steer each read to the correct bank.

kinds.name: XOR-based multi-port register file
kinds.description: Implements multiple write ports by storing in each write port's bank the XOR of the new data with the other banks' contents, so a read XORs all banks at an address to recover the latest value.

kinds.name: Latch-based register file
kinds.description: Uses level-sensitive latches with clock-gated write enables instead of flip-flops for each register word, storing the data in latch rows plus a write-data staging register.

kinds.name: Write-through bypassed register file
kinds.description: Forwards data written in the current cycle directly to any read port that addresses the same register, keeping the register array and a captured copy of the incoming write address and data.

kinds.name: Clustered register file
kinds.description: Partitions registers between execution clusters, each with a local register file and a small number of inter-cluster copy ports, storing per-cluster register arrays and a pending cross-cluster transfer queue.

kinds.name: Checkpointed register file
kinds.description: Takes shadow snapshots of the register state at branch points so it can restore on misprediction, keeping the active register array plus several checkpoint copies and a checkpoint-allocation mask.

kinds.name: Future file
kinds.description: Maintains the most recent speculative value of each architectural register for fast operand reads alongside a separate in-order architectural copy, keeping both arrays and per-register pending-writer tags.

kinds.name: Retirement register file
kinds.description: Holds the committed architectural register values written only when instructions retire from the reorder buffer, plus a per-register flag indicating whether the latest value currently lives in the reorder buffer.

kinds.name: Stack-organized register file
kinds.description: Addresses registers relative to a top-of-stack pointer as in an x87-style floating-point unit, storing the register array, the top pointer and a per-register tag word marking empty or valid slots.

kinds.name: Belt register file
kinds.description: Replaces named destinations with a fixed-length queue of recent results addressed by position from the front, storing the belt slots and a head index advanced as each result drops onto it.

kinds.name: DSP address register file
kinds.description: Holds address, index and modifier registers for a digital signal processor's address generation units, including base and length registers that support circular buffer and bit-reversed addressing.

kinds.name: Deferred-exception tagged register file
kinds.description: Stores each general register together with a not-a-thing poison bit set by speculative loads that faulted, so later consumers can propagate or check the deferred exception.

kinds.name: Asynchronous-read distributed RAM
kinds.description: A small flip-flop or LUT-based memory array written on the clock edge but read combinationally, so the addressed word appears without a clock delay; it keeps only the storage array.

kinds.name: Byte-enable write RAM
kinds.description: A synchronous RAM whose write port takes a per-byte enable mask so only selected byte lanes of the addressed word are updated; it keeps the data array and a registered read-data output.

kinds.name: Dual-clock simple dual-port RAM
kinds.description: A RAM with a write port in one clock domain and a read port in another, used to pass data between domains; it keeps the array plus per-domain address and read-data registers.

kinds.name: Asymmetric-width RAM
kinds.description: A RAM whose write and read ports have different data widths, such as writing 8-bit words and reading 32-bit words, with address mapping between the two aspect ratios; it keeps the shared array and per-port registers.

kinds.name: Double-pumped time-multiplexed RAM
kinds.description: A single-port physical array clocked at twice the system rate to present two logical ports per system cycle; it keeps the array, a phase toggle and holding registers for each logical port's request and result.

kinds.name: Read-modify-write RAM with bypass
kinds.description: A RAM that reads a word, applies an operation such as increment or OR, and writes it back, forwarding in-flight results to back-to-back accesses on the same address; it keeps the array, pipeline stage registers and a bypass address/data register.

kinds.name: Flash-clear valid-bit RAM
kinds.description: A RAM paired with a flip-flop array of per-entry valid bits that can all be cleared in one cycle, making reads of uncleared entries return a default; it keeps the data array and the valid-bit vector.

kinds.name: Epoch-tagged RAM
kinds.description: A RAM where each word stores a generation tag and a global epoch register is bumped to logically invalidate all contents at once; it keeps the data-plus-tag array and the current epoch register.

kinds.name: Zero-initializing RAM
kinds.description: A RAM with a built-in sequencer that sweeps every address writing zeros after reset or on request before accepting normal traffic; it keeps the array, a sweep address counter and an init-busy flag.

kinds.name: RAM-based delay line
kinds.description: A circular RAM written and read at addresses a fixed offset apart to delay a sample stream by many cycles; it keeps the array and a single rolling address counter.

kinds.name: Checkpoint shadow RAM
kinds.description: A RAM duplicated into a working copy and a shadow copy, where a snapshot command records which copy holds committed data so state can be rolled back; it keeps both arrays and a per-entry or global copy-select register.

kinds.name: Paged RAM with bank register
kinds.description: A RAM larger than the address bus can reach, accessed through a window whose upper address bits come from a programmable page register; it keeps the array and the page register.

kinds.name: Auto-increment burst RAM
kinds.description: A RAM with an internal address counter loaded once and then advanced on every access so streams of words can be read or written without supplying addresses; it keeps the array, the address counter and a burst length register.

kinds.name: Bit-addressable RAM
kinds.description: A RAM that, besides word access, supports an alias region in which each address maps to a single bit of an underlying word for atomic bit set and clear; it keeps the word array and a read-modify-write staging register.

kinds.name: Dirty-bit tracking RAM
kinds.description: A RAM that sets a per-block dirty flag whenever any word in that block is written so software can find modified regions; it keeps the data array and a dirty-bit array.

kinds.name: Retention-mode low-power RAM
kinds.description: A RAM wrapper with active, light-sleep and retention modes that gates access and periphery power while preserving contents; it keeps the array, a power-mode register and a wake-up delay counter.

kinds.name: Address-scrambled RAM
kinds.description: A RAM that passes addresses through a keyed permutation and optionally XORs data with a keyed mask to obscure physical layout; it keeps the array and the scrambling key registers.

kinds.name: Posted-write RAM
kinds.description: A synchronous RAM front end that accepts a write into a one-entry pending-write register and commits it to the array on a later idle cycle, matching reads against the pending entry; it keeps the array and the pending address, data and valid registers.

kinds.name: Quarter-wave sine ROM
kinds.description: Stores one quadrant of a sine wave and uses address folding and sign inversion logic to return full-period sine or cosine samples, keeping the quadrant table and an optional registered output word.

kinds.name: FFT twiddle factor ROM
kinds.description: Holds precomputed complex exponential coefficients indexed by butterfly stage and position, keeping real and imaginary coefficient tables and a registered coefficient output pair.

kinds.name: Bipartite table function unit
kinds.description: Approximates a smooth function by adding outputs of a coarse table-of-initial-values and a smaller table-of-offsets indexed by different input bit fields, keeping both tables and the sum register.

kinds.name: Boot ROM with lockout
kinds.description: Supplies the first-stage boot code to the processor after reset and can be hidden from the address map by a sticky disable bit, keeping the code image and the lockout register.

kinds.name: AES S-box ROM
kinds.description: Implements the byte substitution nonlinearity of a block cipher as a 256-entry byte table, keeping the forward (and optionally inverse) substitution tables and a registered output byte.

kinds.name: Filter coefficient ROM
kinds.description: Delivers fixed tap weights to a filter datapath in tap order as an index counter advances, keeping the coefficient table and the tap index register.

kinds.name: Programmable logic array
kinds.description: Generates sum-of-products outputs from a programmable AND plane feeding a programmable OR plane, keeping the configuration bits of both planes and optionally registered outputs.

kinds.name: Color palette LUT
kinds.description: Translates indexed pixel values into full RGB colors for display, keeping a host-writable palette memory and a registered color output.

kinds.name: Table-driven CRC lookup
kinds.description: Advances a CRC by a whole byte per cycle by indexing a 256-entry remainder table with the XOR of the incoming byte and the current CRC high byte, keeping the remainder table and the running CRC register.

kinds.name: Device identification ROM
kinds.description: Exposes read-only vendor, part, revision, and feature-capability words at fixed register addresses, keeping the hardwired ID constants and a read-data output register.

kinds.name: ROM patch unit
kinds.description: Compares fetch addresses against a set of patch address registers and substitutes replacement words when a slot matches, keeping the patch address registers, replacement data registers, and per-slot enable bits.

kinds.name: Galois-field log/antilog ROM
kinds.description: Performs GF(2^m) multiplication and division by looking up discrete logarithms, adding or subtracting them modulo 2^m-1, and looking up the antilog, keeping the log table, antilog table, and an exponent sum register.

kinds.name: Constant-coefficient LUT multiplier
kinds.description: Multiplies a variable input by a fixed constant by splitting the input into nibbles that each index a table of precomputed constant multiples and summing the shifted results, keeping the multiple tables and an adder pipeline register.

kinds.name: Constellation mapper ROM
kinds.description: Maps groups of coded bits to in-phase and quadrature amplitude levels for a selected modulation scheme, keeping I and Q level tables per modulation and a modulation-select register.

kinds.name: Wrap-bit pointer FIFO
kinds.description: Buffers words in a circular RAM using write and read pointers that each carry one extra wrap bit, keeping only the two extended pointers and the storage array, with no separate occupancy counter.

kinds.name: Shift-register FIFO
kinds.description: Stores entries in a chain of registers that all shift toward the output on each pop, with new data written at the position given by a fill-level register.

kinds.name: First-word-fall-through FIFO
kinds.description: Wraps a RAM-based FIFO with an output prefetch register and its valid flag so the head word is visible on the output before a read is requested.

kinds.name: Gray-pointer asynchronous FIFO
kinds.description: Moves data between two clock domains through a dual-port RAM, keeping binary and Gray-coded write and read pointers in their own domains plus synchronized copies of the opposite pointer.

kinds.name: Handshake-synchronized dual-clock FIFO
kinds.description: Crosses clock domains by transferring binary pointer snapshots through a request/acknowledge toggle exchange, holding the local pointers, snapshot holding registers and toggle flags on each side.

kinds.name: Token-ring mixed-clock FIFO
kinds.description: Implements a dual-clock queue as a ring of cells, each with a data register and full/empty bit, where one-hot put and get tokens circulate to select the active cell in each domain.

kinds.name: Mesochronous FIFO
kinds.description: Absorbs a fixed but unknown phase offset between two same-frequency clocks with a small register ring, a write pointer and a read pointer started at a fixed initial separation.

kinds.name: Micropipeline asynchronous FIFO
kinds.description: Forms a clockless queue from a chain of latch stages controlled by Muller C-elements, each stage holding a data latch and a request/acknowledge phase state.

kinds.name: Programmable-watermark FIFO
kinds.description: Adds configurable almost-full and almost-empty threshold registers to a FIFO and keeps registered flags that update when the fill level crosses those thresholds.

kinds.name: Commit/rollback packet FIFO
kinds.description: Supports store-and-forward packet buffering by keeping a speculative write pointer alongside a committed write pointer so a partially written packet can be accepted or discarded at its end.

kinds.name: Asymmetric-width FIFO
kinds.description: Accepts words of one width and delivers words of a different width, keeping a storage array, pointers at the narrow granularity and a sub-word lane index for packing or unpacking.

kinds.name: Overwrite-oldest ring buffer
kinds.description: Continuously records incoming data into a circular array and advances the read pointer past the oldest entry when the array fills, keeping write and read pointers and an overflow flag.

kinds.name: Multi-push FIFO
kinds.description: Accepts several words per cycle through multiple write ports into banked storage, keeping a write pointer that advances by the number of words written and a single read pointer.

kinds.name: Multi-pop FIFO
kinds.description: Delivers up to several consecutive head entries per cycle from banked storage, keeping a read pointer that advances by the number of words consumed and a write pointer.

kinds.name: Peekable lookahead FIFO
kinds.description: Lets the consumer read any of the first several queued entries by offset without dequeuing them, keeping the storage array, head and tail pointers and a peek-offset input path.

kinds.name: Linked-list shared-buffer multi-queue
kinds.description: Holds several logical FIFOs in one shared memory, keeping per-queue head and tail pointers, a next-pointer link array and a free-cell list.

kinds.name: Virtual output queue set
kinds.description: Keeps a separate FIFO for each output destination at an input port so blocked traffic for one destination does not hold up others, with per-queue pointers and nonempty flags.

kinds.name: Multicast multi-reader FIFO
kinds.description: Lets several consumers read the same written stream at their own pace, keeping one write pointer, a per-reader read pointer, and the shared storage array.

kinds.name: Replay retransmission buffer
kinds.description: Holds transmitted frames until acknowledged so they can be resent, keeping a write pointer, an acknowledged pointer, a replay pointer and a replay-active flag.

kinds.name: Clock-compensation elastic buffer
kinds.description: Bridges a recovered receive clock and a local clock in a serial link by inserting or deleting skip symbols, keeping a circular data array, write and read pointers and skip-insert/delete control flags.

kinds.name: Collapsing queue
kinds.description: Allows entries to be removed from any position while remaining entries shift down to close the gaps, keeping an ordered array of entry registers each with a valid bit.

kinds.name: Double-ended queue
kinds.description: Supports push and pop at both the head and the tail of a circular buffer, keeping front and back pointers and the storage array.

kinds.name: Timestamped delay queue
kinds.description: Holds each entry with a release time and lets the head leave only once a free-running time counter reaches that time, keeping per-entry data and timestamp fields, pointers and the time counter.

kinds.name: Hybrid flop-SRAM cascaded FIFO
kinds.description: Combines a small register FIFO in front of and behind a large SRAM FIFO to hide RAM latency, keeping the head and tail flop stages, the SRAM pointers and a bypass-select state.

kinds.name: Longest-prefix-match engine
kinds.description: Stores prefix/length entries in parallel comparators and returns the address of the matching entry with the longest prefix, keeping a prefix array, a length array and per-entry valid bits.

kinds.name: Range-match CAM
kinds.description: Compares a search key against stored lower and upper bounds in every entry at once and reports which entries contain the key, keeping low-bound registers, high-bound registers and valid bits.

kinds.name: Precomputation-filter CAM
kinds.description: Stores a small precomputed signature such as a ones-count beside each key so that only entries with a matching signature run the full compare, keeping key, signature and valid arrays.

kinds.name: Banked hierarchical CAM
kinds.description: Splits entries into banks chosen by a few key bits and searches only the selected bank in parallel, keeping per-bank key arrays, valid bits and a bank-occupancy register.

kinds.name: Key-value associative memory
kinds.description: Searches stored keys in parallel and on a hit reads out the paired data word, keeping a key array, a value array, valid bits and a registered hit/data result.

kinds.name: Sorted-array binary-search CAM emulator
kinds.description: Emulates CAM lookup by keeping keys sorted in RAM and running a multi-cycle binary search, holding the sorted key RAM, an entry count and low/high/mid search pointers.

kinds.name: SRAM bit-slice CAM emulator
kinds.description: Splits the key into slices that each index a RAM of per-entry match vectors and ANDs the vectors to find matches, keeping one match-vector table per slice and a valid-entry mask.

kinds.name: Hamming-distance approximate CAM
kinds.description: Counts mismatched bits between the search key and every stored entry in parallel and flags entries within a programmable distance, keeping key storage, valid bits and a threshold register.

kinds.name: Nearest-neighbor associative memory
kinds.description: Computes a distance from the query to every stored vector and returns the address of the closest one, keeping the vector array, valid bits and registered best-index and best-distance values.

kinds.name: Global-mask search CAM
kinds.description: Applies a programmable search mask so selected key bits are ignored across all entries during a lookup, keeping a key array, valid bits and a global mask register.

kinds.name: Age-stamped CAM
kinds.description: Attaches an insertion timestamp to each entry so the oldest match or oldest entry can be chosen for reporting or eviction, keeping key, timestamp and valid arrays plus a global time counter.

kinds.name: Round-robin replacement CAM
kinds.description: Fully associative lookup table that writes new keys into the slot named by a rotating insertion pointer, keeping key storage, valid bits and the insertion-pointer register.

kinds.name: Tag-broadcast wakeup array
kinds.description: Compares broadcast result tags against the source-operand tags of waiting entries in parallel and sets their ready bits on a match, keeping source tag fields, ready bits and entry valid bits.

kinds.name: Pipelined CAM
kinds.description: Splits the key comparison across pipeline stages so each stage narrows a partial match vector, keeping the key array, valid bits and per-stage partial-match and key registers.

kinds.name: Multi-port search CAM
kinds.description: Runs two or more independent key searches against the same entry set in one cycle, keeping a shared key array, valid bits and a separate match-result register for each port.

kinds.name: Searchable FIFO
kinds.description: An in-order queue whose entries can also be searched in parallel by content to report the position of a matching element, keeping entry data, valid bits and head/tail pointers.

kinds.name: Layer-2 MAC learning table
kinds.description: Learns source addresses with their ingress ports and looks up destination addresses in parallel to return a port, keeping MAC keys, port fields, valid bits and per-entry aging bits refreshed on hits.

kinds.name: Flow match table with hit counters
kinds.description: Matches packet header fields against stored flow keys and returns the matching rule while bumping that rule's packet and byte counters, keeping key, action, counter and valid arrays.

kinds.name: Sliding-window string-match CAM
kinds.description: Shifts an input byte stream through a window register and compares it against all stored patterns in parallel each cycle, keeping the pattern array, pattern valid bits and the window shift register.

kinds.name: Bit-serial associative processor
kinds.description: Searches all words in parallel one bit column at a time, narrowing a per-word response tag, keeping the word array, a comparand register, a mask register and the response-tag register.

kinds.name: Outstanding transaction ID CAM
kinds.description: Records the IDs of issued bus transactions and finds the matching slot when a response returns, keeping ID fields, per-slot metadata and allocated bits.

kinds.name: Heavy-hitter counting CAM
kinds.description: Looks up incoming keys in parallel, increments the count of a matching entry or replaces the lowest-count entry on a miss, keeping key, count and valid arrays.

kinds.name: Search-and-update CAM
kinds.description: Performs a parallel search and in the same operation overwrites the data or flags of the matching entry, keeping key and data arrays, valid bits and a pending-update register.

kinds.name: Bidirectional associative map
kinds.description: Holds paired fields that can each be searched in parallel, so a lookup by either key or value returns the address and the partner field, keeping two content arrays and valid bits.

kinds.name: Fully-associative cache
kinds.description: Stores lines in any entry by comparing the request address against every stored tag in parallel, keeping per-entry tag, valid, dirty and data registers plus replacement state.

kinds.name: Sector cache
kinds.description: Shares one address tag across several sub-blocks of a line, keeping one tag per sector and separate valid and dirty bits per sub-block so that sub-blocks can be filled independently.

kinds.name: Skewed-associative cache
kinds.description: Indexes each way with a different hash of the address to spread conflicting lines, keeping per-way tag, valid and data arrays along with the hash function configuration.

kinds.name: Column-associative cache
kinds.description: Probes a primary set and then a rehashed alternate set in a direct-mapped array, keeping tag and data arrays plus a per-line rehash bit that records which index function placed the line.

kinds.name: Write-back eviction buffer
kinds.description: Holds dirty lines evicted from the cache until they drain to the next memory level, keeping entries of victim address, data and valid flags that later requests can match against.

kinds.name: Write-combining buffer
kinds.description: Merges multiple partial stores to the same line into one burst write, keeping a line address, data bytes and a per-byte write mask for each entry.

kinds.name: MESI line state controller
kinds.description: Updates a cache line's coherence state on local reads, writes and incoming snoops, keeping a two-bit Modified/Exclusive/Shared/Invalid state per line and issuing bus or interconnect requests.

kinds.name: Snooping bus cache controller
kinds.description: Watches the shared bus for other masters' transactions, looks up their addresses in a duplicate tag copy and supplies data, invalidates or downgrades lines, keeping the duplicate tags and a pending-snoop register.

kinds.name: Way predictor
kinds.description: Guesses which way of a set-associative cache will hit so that only one data way needs to be read, keeping a table of predicted way numbers indexed by address or PC bits.

kinds.name: Next-line prefetcher
kinds.description: Issues a fetch for the line following each demand miss, keeping the last miss address and a small queue of outstanding prefetch addresses.

kinds.name: Stream buffer
kinds.description: Prefetches sequential lines after a miss into a small FIFO beside the cache and supplies them on later misses, keeping the stream head address, entry tags, valid bits and line data.

kinds.name: Loop buffer
kinds.description: Captures the instructions of a short backward-branching loop so that fetch can replay them without accessing the instruction cache, keeping instruction entries, the loop start and end addresses, and a capture or replay mode flag.

kinds.name: Trace cache
kinds.description: Stores dynamic instruction sequences that span taken branches as single lines, keeping per-line start address, branch outcome flags, instruction slots and the next fetch address.

kinds.name: Micro-op cache
kinds.description: Caches decoded micro-operations keyed by instruction fetch address so the decoders can be bypassed, keeping tag, valid, micro-op slot and replacement registers for each way.

kinds.name: Random replacement unit
kinds.description: Selects a victim way pseudo-randomly on each fill, keeping a free-running pseudo-random state register and a mask of ways eligible for replacement.

kinds.name: Round-robin replacement pointer
kinds.description: Chooses victims in a fixed rotating order within each set, keeping a per-set next-victim way pointer that advances on every fill.

kinds.name: RRIP replacement unit
kinds.description: Predicts how soon each line will be reused and evicts a line predicted to be reused far in the future, keeping a small re-reference prediction counter per line that ages when no candidate is found.

kinds.name: LFU replacement unit
kinds.description: Evicts the least frequently accessed line in a set, keeping a per-line access-frequency counter that increments on hits and is periodically halved.

kinds.name: Set-dueling policy monitor
kinds.description: Dedicates a few sample sets to each of two replacement or insertion policies and steers the remaining sets toward the policy that misses less, keeping a policy-selection counter and the sample-set designations.

kinds.name: Dead-block predictor
kinds.description: Predicts when a cached line will not be referenced again so it can be evicted early or bypassed, keeping a table of signature-indexed confidence counters and a per-line signature field.

kinds.name: Cache maintenance engine
kinds.description: Walks the cache by set and way to clean, invalidate or flush lines on software command, keeping current set and way index registers, the operation type and a busy status bit.

kinds.name: Cache lockdown controller
kinds.description: Pins selected lines or ways so they are excluded from replacement, keeping a way-lock mask register and per-line lock bits set by software.

kinds.name: Way-partitioning controller
kinds.description: Restricts which cache ways each requester or quality-of-service class may allocate into, keeping a per-class allocation way-mask register file.

kinds.name: Inclusive back-invalidation unit
kinds.description: Sends invalidations to upper-level caches whenever the lower-level inclusive cache evicts a line, keeping a queue of pending back-invalidate addresses and per-line presence bits for the upper caches.

kinds.name: Cache ECC scrubber
kinds.description: Periodically reads cache lines in the background, corrects single-bit errors and writes the corrected data back, keeping a scrub address pointer, an interval timer and error count registers.

kinds.name: FR-FCFS DRAM command scheduler
kinds.description: Picks the next DRAM command from a pending request queue, favoring row-buffer hits and then the oldest request, and keeps per-entry age stamps, target bank/row fields and a ready mask.

kinds.name: Open-row bank state table
kinds.description: Tracks for each DRAM bank whether a row is open and which row it is, holding a per-bank valid bit and open-row address register used to classify requests as hit, miss or conflict.

kinds.name: DRAM timing constraint tracker
kinds.description: Gates ACT, RD, WR and PRE issue per bank using countdown timers for tRCD, tRP, tRAS, tRC and tWR, loaded on each command and decremented every cycle.

kinds.name: Four-activate window (tFAW) tracker
kinds.description: Limits row activations per rank by holding timestamps of the most recent four ACT commands in a small circular history and a pointer to the oldest one.

kinds.name: Bus turnaround controller
kinds.description: Inserts read-to-write, write-to-read and rank-to-rank gaps on the shared data bus, keeping the last command type, last rank ID and turnaround countdown registers such as tWTR and tRTW.

kinds.name: Mode register programming unit
kinds.description: Issues MRS/MRW commands that load CAS latency, burst length, ODT and drive-strength settings into the DRAM, keeping shadow copies of each mode register and a pending-update flag set.

kinds.name: Physical address mapper
kinds.description: Splits a system address into channel, rank, bank group, bank, row and column fields with optional XOR bank hashing, holding configurable field-position and hash-mask registers.

kinds.name: Read-after-write hazard detector
kinds.description: Compares incoming read addresses against pending entries in the write queue and forwards or stalls on a match, keeping an address/byte-mask array of queued writes and a match vector.

kinds.name: Adaptive page-close timer
kinds.description: Precharges idle open rows after a programmable idle interval, keeping a per-bank idle counter and a timeout register adjusted by observed hit and conflict counts.

kinds.name: Power-down and self-refresh controller
kinds.description: Puts ranks into precharge power-down or self-refresh after sustained idleness and wakes them on demand, holding idle counters, the current low-power state per rank and exit-latency timers.

kinds.name: ZQ calibration scheduler
kinds.description: Periodically issues ZQ short calibration commands to retune DRAM output impedance, keeping an interval counter, a calibration-in-progress flag and a blocking-period timer.

kinds.name: Temperature-compensated refresh adjuster
kinds.description: Polls the DRAM temperature status mode register and scales the refresh interval, holding the last read temperature code, a poll timer and the active refresh-rate multiplier.

kinds.name: Row-hammer activation counter table
kinds.description: Counts activations to recently used rows and triggers targeted neighbor-row refreshes when a threshold is reached, keeping a small table of row addresses with per-row activate counters.

kinds.name: Write leveling training engine
kinds.description: Sweeps DQS output delay relative to CK during write leveling mode and samples the DRAM feedback on DQ, keeping a delay tap register, sampled result history and the found-edge setting per byte lane.

kinds.name: Read DQS gate training unit
kinds.description: Searches for the correct receive-enable window for the read strobe by stepping coarse and fine delay settings, holding current delay taps, pass/fail records and the chosen gate setting per lane.

kinds.name: Read eye centering unit
kinds.description: Sweeps per-bit DQ capture delays against a known pattern to find the left and right eye edges, storing edge tap registers and the computed center delay for each data bit.

kinds.name: DFI PHY interface aligner
kinds.description: Translates controller commands and write data onto the DFI interface with programmed write-latency and read-enable delays, keeping latency configuration registers and delay pipelines for command and data-enable signals.

kinds.name: Command/address parity retry unit
kinds.description: Computes parity on each issued command and address, logs commands in a replay history and re-issues them after the DRAM signals a parity alert, holding the history buffer, a replay pointer and an error status register.

kinds.name: Data bus inversion encoder
kinds.description: Inverts a byte lane on write when more than half its bits would be driven low and restores data on read, keeping the per-lane DBI flag registers for the current beat.

kinds.name: Asynchronous SRAM/NOR bus controller
kinds.description: Generates chip-select, output-enable and write-enable strobes with programmable setup, access and hold wait states for external parallel memories, keeping per-chip-select timing registers and a phase counter.

kinds.name: HyperBus/PSRAM controller
kinds.description: Serializes requests into command-address phases, latency waits and DDR data bursts for HyperRAM or OctalSPI PSRAM, honoring the maximum chip-select low time, and holds latency configuration, a burst byte counter and a CS-low duration timer.

kinds.name: Odd-ratio 50% duty divider
kinds.description: Divides a clock by an odd integer with a symmetric output by combining a rising-edge modulo counter with a falling-edge retimed copy, keeping the count register and the rising- and falling-edge phase flops.

kinds.name: Half-integer clock divider
kinds.description: Produces a clock at the input frequency divided by N.5 by alternating edge selection between rising and falling input edges, keeping a modulo counter and an edge-select toggle bit.

kinds.name: Fractional-N modulus controller
kinds.description: Generates a per-cycle divide-ratio sequence whose average equals an integer plus a fraction using a multi-stage sigma-delta modulator, keeping the integer and fraction setting registers and the modulator accumulator registers.

kinds.name: Rational M/N clock-enable generator
kinds.description: Emits an enable pulse on exactly M of every N input cycles using a Bresenham-style error accumulator, keeping the M and N configuration registers and the running error register.

kinds.name: Programmable divider with shadowed ratio
kinds.description: Divides a clock by a software-set ratio that only takes effect at a period boundary, keeping a shadow ratio register, an active ratio register and the period counter.

kinds.name: Multi-output phase-offset clock generator
kinds.description: Produces several divided clocks from one source, each with its own programmable phase offset relative to a shared cycle counter, keeping the shared counter and per-output divide and offset registers.

kinds.name: Phase-frequency detector
kinds.description: Compares reference and feedback clock edges and asserts UP or DOWN pulses proportional to their phase difference, keeping the UP and DN flops that are cleared together by a reset path.

kinds.name: Bang-bang phase detector
kinds.description: Samples the reference clock with the feedback clock (or vice versa) to produce a single early/late decision per cycle, keeping the sampling flop and a registered early/late output.

kinds.name: Digitally controlled oscillator control word
kinds.description: Converts a tuning code into enables for capacitor or inverter banks in a digitally controlled ring or LC oscillator, keeping the coarse, medium and fine tuning code registers.

kinds.name: DCO band calibration engine
kinds.description: Selects the coarse frequency band of a digitally controlled oscillator by successive-approximation search against a reference count, keeping the trial code register, the bit-position pointer and the measured count.

kinds.name: Frequency-locked loop counter comparator
kinds.description: Counts oscillator cycles over a fixed reference window and nudges the oscillator code up or down toward a target count, keeping the cycle counter, the window timer, the target register and the oscillator code.

kinds.name: PLL startup sequencer
kinds.description: Steps a PLL through power-up, band calibration, loop closure and lock wait before releasing the output clock, keeping a sequence state register and a settle-time counter.

kinds.name: Spread-spectrum clock modulator
kinds.description: Periodically sweeps a PLL's fractional divide setting along a triangular profile to spread the clock's spectral energy, keeping the profile step counter, direction bit and current offset register.

kinds.name: Missing-clock detector
kinds.description: Watches a monitored clock with a counter running on an independent clock and flags a failure when no monitored edge arrives within a timeout, keeping the timeout counter, a synchronized edge-toggle sample and a failure flag.

kinds.name: Clock failover switch controller
kinds.description: Automatically moves the system clock from a primary to a backup source when the primary is reported failed, keeping a selected-source register, a switch-in-progress flag and a sticky failover status bit.

kinds.name: Ring oscillator clock source
kinds.description: Generates a free-running clock from an odd chain of inverters gated by an enable, keeping only the enable register and a trim register selecting the chain length.

kinds.name: Edge-combining frequency doubler
kinds.description: Produces a clock at twice the input frequency by XORing the input with a delayed copy of itself, keeping a delay-select register that sets the output pulse width.

kinds.name: Clock pulse swallower
kinds.description: Removes selected cycles from a clock stream according to a programmed skip pattern to lower its effective frequency, keeping the pattern register, a pattern position counter and the gating latch.

kinds.name: Adaptive clock stretcher
kinds.description: Lengthens the next clock cycles when a supply-droop detector fires and restores normal period afterward, keeping a stretch-active flag, a recovery counter and a stretch-amount register.

kinds.name: Clock burst generator
kinds.description: Emits exactly N clock pulses on request and then holds the output idle, keeping the requested-count register, a remaining-pulse counter and a burst-active flag.

kinds.name: Toggle pulse synchronizer
kinds.description: Converts a source-domain pulse into a toggle of a source register, synchronizes that toggle through destination flops, and XORs the last two stages to regenerate a destination pulse.

kinds.name: Two-phase (NRZ) handshake synchronizer
kinds.description: Signals transfers by toggling a request register in the sender and an acknowledge register in the receiver, each synchronized into the opposite domain through flop chains.

kinds.name: Mux-recirculation data synchronizer
kinds.description: Holds a multi-bit bus in a source register and synchronizes only a load-enable bit, which selects a destination capture register to load the bus or recirculate its current value.

kinds.name: MCP bus synchronizer with acknowledge feedback
kinds.description: Launches a held data word with a toggled enable, synchronizes the enable to capture the word in the destination, and returns a synchronized acknowledge toggle that frees the source holding register.

kinds.name: Asynchronous FIFO flag generator
kinds.description: Compares a local pointer with a synchronized copy of the remote Gray pointer to produce registered full, empty, almost-full and almost-empty flags, keeping the synchronizer stages and flag registers.

kinds.name: Clock-gate enable synchronizer
kinds.description: Synchronizes a gating request into the target clock domain and latches it on the inactive clock phase so the integrated clock gate receives a stable enable, keeping the sync flops and the enable latch.

kinds.name: Metastability-detecting synchronizer
kinds.description: Samples an asynchronous input in parallel flops and flags disagreement between the main and a shadow sampling register, keeping both sample registers and an error-flag register.

kinds.name: Mesochronous phase-select synchronizer
kinds.description: Captures data from a same-frequency, unknown-phase clock into two alternately clocked registers and uses a calibrated phase-select register to pick the safe one for the receiver.

kinds.name: Ratiochronous transfer-window scheduler
kinds.description: For clocks with a known rational frequency ratio, uses a phase counter register to predict safe sampling edges and enables direct transfers only within those windows.

kinds.name: Sticky status bit synchronizer with clear handshake
kinds.description: Latches asynchronous status events into a sticky register in the source domain, synchronizes it to software's domain, and clears it via a synchronized clear-request toggle.

kinds.name: Snapshot capture synchronizer
kinds.description: On a destination request toggle, freezes a source-domain running value into a snapshot register and returns a completion toggle so the destination can safely read the frozen value.

kinds.name: Pulse-pending counter synchronizer
kinds.description: Accumulates bursts of fast-domain pulses in a pending counter and drains them one at a time through a handshake into a slower domain, keeping the counter and handshake toggle registers.

kinds.name: Asynchronous-set wakeup synchronizer
kinds.description: Uses a flop asynchronously set by an external wake event with no clock running, then synchronizes it into the newly started clock domain and clears it on a synchronized acknowledge.

kinds.name: Cross-domain register access bridge
kinds.description: Carries bus read/write transactions between domains by holding address, write data and read data in registers and exchanging request and response toggles through synchronizers.

kinds.name: Source-synchronous input capture
kinds.description: Samples incoming data with a forwarded clock into capture registers and writes them into a small dual-clock buffer read by the local clock, keeping capture flops and buffer slots.

kinds.name: Johnson-code pointer synchronizer
kinds.description: Encodes a short FIFO or sequence pointer as a Johnson (twisted-ring) code register and synchronizes it through flop chains into the other domain for decoding.

kinds.name: Pausible clock controller
kinds.description: Stretches or pauses a local ring-oscillator clock while an asynchronous handshake is resolved by a mutual-exclusion element, keeping the clock-enable state and the handshake latch.

kinds.name: Mutual-exclusion request arbiter
kinds.description: Resolves two asynchronous requests with a cross-coupled latch followed by a metastability filter, holding which requester currently owns the shared resource.

kinds.name: Multi-domain reset sequencer
kinds.description: Releases resets to several domains in a programmed order with configurable delays, keeping a step index, a delay counter and a per-domain reset-asserted register.

kinds.name: Reset cause recorder
kinds.description: Captures which source triggered the most recent reset (power-on, brown-out, watchdog, software, pin), holding sticky cause flags in an always-on register that software reads and clears.

kinds.name: Software reset control block
kinds.description: Exposes per-peripheral reset bits that software sets and clears to hold or release individual blocks, keeping a reset-control register and an optional self-clearing pulse timer.

kinds.name: Reset escalation controller
kinds.description: Promotes repeated local fault resets to a broader subsystem or chip-wide reset, keeping a fault occurrence counter, an escalation level register and a decay timer.

kinds.name: Warm reset quiesce handshaker
kinds.description: Before applying a warm reset it requests bus masters to drain and blocks new transactions, keeping a quiesce-request flag, per-port idle acknowledgment bits and a timeout counter.

kinds.name: Reset domain crossing gate
kinds.description: Clamps signals leaving a domain that is in reset so they do not corrupt a domain still running, keeping a registered reset-state indicator and the clamp-enable flop.

kinds.name: Brown-out detector filter
kinds.description: Digitally qualifies a comparator's low-voltage indication and raises a brown-out event or reset, keeping a debounce counter, a threshold-select register and a brown-out status flag.

kinds.name: Power-good qualifier
kinds.description: Synchronizes and validates power-good signals from regulators before letting dependent logic proceed, keeping per-rail synchronizer flops, stability counters and a qualified-good register.

kinds.name: State retention controller
kinds.description: Sequences save and restore strobes to retention flip-flops around a power-down, keeping a retention phase register, a save-done flag and a restore-pending flag.

kinds.name: Staggered power-switch enabler
kinds.description: Turns on power-switch segments of a domain one group at a time to limit in-rush current, keeping a segment index, an inter-step delay counter and the switch-enable shift chain.

kinds.name: Power mode state machine
kinds.description: Moves the chip among run, idle, sleep and deep-sleep modes on software and wake requests, keeping the current power mode, a pending request register and per-mode configuration registers.

kinds.name: Wake-up event controller
kinds.description: Collects wake sources such as GPIO edges, timers and interrupts during sleep, keeping a wake-enable mask, a sticky wake-pending register and edge-polarity configuration bits.

kinds.name: Low-power interface channel controller
kinds.description: Implements a request/accept/deny low-power handshake (Q-channel/P-channel style) with a device before cutting its clock or power, keeping the channel state, requested power state and accept/deny status.

kinds.name: Idle-based auto power-down unit
kinds.description: Watches a block's activity and requests clock or power removal after a programmable idle period, keeping an idle counter, a threshold register and a power-down-requested flag.

kinds.name: Power domain dependency tracker
kinds.description: Keeps parent domains powered while any child domain or requester needs them, holding per-domain usage reference counts and a domain-on vector.

kinds.name: Adaptive voltage scaling monitor
kinds.description: Measures silicon speed with replica-path or ring-oscillator counts and requests voltage up or down steps, keeping a measurement counter, target margin registers and the last adjustment code.

kinds.name: Voltage ramp sequencer
kinds.description: Steps a regulator setpoint gradually from current to target voltage at a programmed slew rate, keeping the current setpoint code, the target code and a step interval timer.

kinds.name: Power capping throttle controller
kinds.description: Estimates power from activity counters and throttles issue rate or clock frequency to stay within a budget, keeping an accumulated energy estimate, a budget register and a throttle level.

kinds.name: Body-bias controller
kinds.description: Selects forward or reverse well bias levels per domain for speed or leakage trade-offs and sequences transitions, keeping the bias mode register, a target level code and a settle timer.

kinds.name: Power-switch acknowledge monitor
kinds.description: Tracks the daisy-chained acknowledge returning from a domain's power switches and reports when the domain is fully on or off, keeping the ack synchronizer flops, a domain status register and a timeout counter.

kinds.name: Debug power request handler
kinds.description: Holds selected power domains on and blocks sleep while an external debugger requests access, keeping a debug power-up request register, a per-domain keep-alive mask and an acknowledgment flag.

kinds.name: Matrix arbiter
kinds.description: Grants the least-recently-served requester by consulting an N-by-N priority matrix of flip-flops, updating the winner's row and column after each grant.

kinds.name: Weighted round-robin arbiter
kinds.description: Cycles through requesters in turn but lets each hold the grant for several consecutive slots, keeping a rotating pointer, per-requester weight registers and a remaining-slots counter.

kinds.name: Deficit round-robin scheduler
kinds.description: Serves variable-size requests in rotation by adding a quantum to each requester's deficit counter per round and granting while the head request fits, keeping per-requester deficit registers and a round pointer.

kinds.name: Lottery arbiter
kinds.description: Picks a winner randomly in proportion to programmable ticket counts, holding per-requester ticket registers and an LFSR that supplies the random draw.

kinds.name: FIFO queuing arbiter
kinds.description: Grants requesters in the order their requests arrived, recording arriving requester IDs in a small order queue with head and tail pointers.

kinds.name: Hierarchical tree arbiter
kinds.description: Splits requesters into groups with a local arbiter per group and a root arbiter choosing among groups, keeping a priority pointer in each local and root node.

kinds.name: Separable input-first switch allocator
kinds.description: Matches router inputs to outputs in two stages, first picking one request per input then one input per output, keeping a round-robin pointer register in every input and output arbiter.

kinds.name: iSLIP allocator
kinds.description: Performs iterative request-grant-accept matching between switch inputs and outputs, keeping a grant pointer per output and an accept pointer per input that advance only on accepted matches.

kinds.name: Wavefront allocator
kinds.description: Computes a crossbar matching by sweeping priority diagonally across a request matrix of cells, keeping a register that selects which diagonal starts with top priority each cycle.

kinds.name: TDMA slot arbiter
kinds.description: Grants the resource according to a fixed time-division schedule, keeping a slot counter and a programmable schedule table mapping each slot to an owner.

kinds.name: Bus parking arbiter
kinds.description: Leaves the grant on a default or most-recent master when no one requests, keeping a park-master register and the current owner register to avoid re-arbitration latency.

kinds.name: Token-passing ring arbiter
kinds.description: Circulates a single token among requesters so only the holder may use the resource, keeping a token-position register that moves forward when the holder releases or has no request.

kinds.name: Aging-promotion priority arbiter
kinds.description: Uses strict priority but raises a low-priority requester's effective level once it has waited too long, keeping per-requester starvation timers and promoted-level flags.

kinds.name: Burst-hold arbiter
kinds.description: Keeps the grant on the current winner until its multi-beat transaction finishes, holding an owner register and a beats-remaining counter loaded from the burst length.

kinds.name: K-of-N multi-grant arbiter
kinds.description: Issues up to K simultaneous grants to distinct requesters per cycle for a K-ported resource, keeping a rotating start pointer and a grant vector register.

kinds.name: Earliest-deadline-first arbiter
kinds.description: Grants the pending requester whose deadline is nearest, keeping a countdown deadline register per requester reloaded from a programmable period on each grant.

kinds.name: Read/write turnaround arbiter
kinds.description: Chooses between read and write queues while batching same-direction accesses to limit bus turnarounds, keeping a current-direction register and a batch-length counter.

kinds.name: Banked memory conflict arbiter
kinds.description: Resolves simultaneous accesses from many ports to multiple memory banks by arbitrating separately per bank, keeping a priority pointer per bank and a per-port stall register.

kinds.name: Exponential backoff arbiter
kinds.description: Makes losing requesters wait a randomized, doubling delay before retrying, keeping per-requester backoff counters, collision-count registers and an LFSR for jitter.

kinds.name: Bandwidth-regulated QoS arbiter
kinds.description: Lets real-time requesters win by priority only while their per-period byte budgets last, keeping per-requester consumed-bytes counters and a regulation-period timer that resets them.

kinds.name: Wishbone shared-bus intercon
kinds.description: Connects several Wishbone masters to several slaves over one shared bus, holding a current-owner register and a cycle-active flag that keeps the owning master on the bus while CYC is asserted.

kinds.name: Wishbone-to-AXI bridge
kinds.description: Converts Wishbone classic or pipelined cycles into AXI4 read and write transactions, keeping a pending-request register, an address/data holding latch and a phase-state register for the AW/W/B or AR/R sequence.

kinds.name: AHB-to-AXI bridge
kinds.description: Translates AHB-Lite address and data phases into AXI channel transactions, storing the captured HADDR/HSIZE/HBURST control, a write-data buffer and a waiting-for-response state register used to drive HREADY.

kinds.name: AHB multilayer input stage
kinds.description: Sits at each master port of an AHB bus matrix and captures an address phase when the target slave layer is busy, holding the pending transfer's control signals and a pending-valid flag until the layer accepts it.

kinds.name: AHB default slave
kinds.description: Answers accesses to unmapped AHB addresses with a two-cycle ERROR response, keeping a small response-phase state register.

kinds.name: AXI default slave
kinds.description: Terminates AXI transactions routed to unmapped regions with DECERR responses, storing the accepted ID, a burst-length countdown for returning read beats and a pending write-response flag.

kinds.name: AXI4-Lite to AXI4 upconverter
kinds.description: Lets an AXI4-Lite master reach a full AXI4 fabric by adding fixed ID, length and burst fields, keeping registered copies of the in-flight read and write requests.

kinds.name: AXI4-to-AXI4-Lite downconverter
kinds.description: Breaks full AXI4 bursts into single-beat AXI4-Lite accesses, holding the original ID, a beat-remaining counter, the running address and an accumulated worst-case response register.

kinds.name: AXI ID remapper
kinds.description: Compresses wide upstream transaction IDs into a smaller downstream ID space, keeping a table of remapped-ID entries each with its original ID and an outstanding-transaction count.

kinds.name: AXI data-width upsizer
kinds.description: Packs narrow AXI write beats into wider downstream beats and unpacks wide read beats, storing a packing buffer with byte-strobe mask, a lane-offset pointer and the captured burst size and length.

kinds.name: AXI data-width downsizer
kinds.description: Splits wide AXI beats into multiple narrow beats for a narrower slave, keeping the wide data word being drained, a sub-beat index and a re-merge register for assembling read responses.

kinds.name: AXI clock-domain crossing bridge
kinds.description: Carries all five AXI channels between asynchronous clock domains using per-channel dual-clock storage, holding the payload memories plus write and read pointers on each side.

kinds.name: AXI 4KB boundary burst splitter
kinds.description: Divides incoming AXI bursts that would cross a 4KB page into legal sub-bursts, storing the remaining length, next start address and a count of sub-bursts whose responses must be merged.

kinds.name: AXI write-channel ordering queue
kinds.description: Routes W-channel data in an interconnect to the slave chosen by each accepted AW request, keeping a queue of destination port indices in address-acceptance order.

kinds.name: AXI exclusive access monitor
kinds.description: Supports AXI exclusive load/store pairs by tracking reservations, storing per-master reservation address, size and valid bits that are cleared by conflicting writes.

kinds.name: AXI-Stream switch
kinds.description: Routes AXI-Stream packets from several input ports to output ports according to TDEST, holding per-output current-input selection and a packet-in-progress lock cleared on TLAST.

kinds.name: AXI QoS regulator
kinds.description: Shapes a master's bandwidth and latency by adjusting AxQOS or stalling requests, holding configured rate and burstiness registers, an accumulated byte budget and a latency target register.

kinds.name: Bus timeout monitor
kinds.description: Watches outstanding transactions on a bus port and forces an error response if a slave stalls too long, keeping per-transaction cycle counters, a timeout threshold register and a sticky timeout status bit.

kinds.name: Bus performance monitor
kinds.description: Observes handshakes on an interconnect port and accumulates statistics, holding counters for transactions, bytes moved, stall cycles and cumulative latency plus a sampling-window register.

kinds.name: Address remap unit
kinds.description: Rewrites transaction addresses through programmable windows before decoding, such as aliasing boot ROM to address zero, storing per-window source base, size, target base and enable registers.

kinds.name: AHB split-transaction controller
kinds.description: Lets an AHB slave issue SPLIT responses and later signal readiness to resume, keeping a mask of split-pending masters and the HSPLIT bits it drives back to the arbiter.

kinds.name: Virtual-channel state table
kinds.description: Tracks per-input-VC progress through the router pipeline, holding for each VC a state field (idle, routing, waiting for VC, active), the computed output port and the assigned output VC.

kinds.name: Output VC status register
kinds.description: Records for each downstream virtual channel whether it is currently reserved by a packet, plus the identity of the input VC that holds it.

kinds.name: Speculative switch allocator
kinds.description: Lets head flits bid for crossbar slots in parallel with VC allocation and gives non-speculative requests precedence, holding separate priority registers for the speculative and non-speculative request classes.

kinds.name: Table-based routing lookup
kinds.description: Maps a packet's destination ID to an output port through a programmable routing table memory, with configuration write registers for updating entries.

kinds.name: Lookahead route computation unit
kinds.description: Computes the output port a packet will take at the next-hop router and writes it into the flit header, keeping a registered copy of the current router's coordinates and the precomputed next-hop direction.

kinds.name: Odd-even adaptive output selector
kinds.description: Chooses among the minimal output directions permitted by odd-even turn rules by comparing downstream congestion indicators, holding registered coordinates and the latest congestion values for each candidate port.

kinds.name: Source-route header shifter
kinds.description: Pops the next hop field from a source-routed packet header to select the output port and shifts the remaining route bits, holding the current route vector register.

kinds.name: Flit type decoder
kinds.description: Classifies incoming flits as head, body, tail or single-flit and extracts destination, VC and message class fields into registered header fields.

kinds.name: Packetizer network interface
kinds.description: Splits outgoing messages from a core into header and payload flits for injection, holding the pending message register, a flit index counter and the assigned packet sequence number.

kinds.name: Deflection port assigner
kinds.description: In a bufferless router, assigns every arriving flit to some output port each cycle, deflecting losers to free ports by rank, and keeps per-flit age or hop-count fields used to rank them.

kinds.name: Age-based arbiter
kinds.description: Grants contending flits by oldest injection timestamp, holding a timestamp register per request slot and a local cycle counter for computing age.

kinds.name: Escape VC controller
kinds.description: Steers packets into a deadlock-free escape virtual channel restricted to dimension-order routing when adaptive VCs are blocked, keeping per-packet escape flags and a blocked-cycles counter.

kinds.name: Bubble flow control gate
kinds.description: Admits a packet into a ring or torus dimension only if enough free buffer slots would remain, keeping a free-slot count register for the downstream ring buffer.

kinds.name: Regional congestion monitor
kinds.description: Aggregates local buffer occupancy with congestion values received from neighbors into a per-direction congestion metric, holding a filtered congestion register for each port.

kinds.name: Express bypass latch
kinds.description: Lets a flit skip the buffer-write and allocation stages when the input is idle and a lookahead signal has pre-reserved the crossbar, keeping a bypass-valid flag and the latched flit.

kinds.name: Link fault status register
kinds.description: Records which router links are disabled due to faults and masks them out of routing decisions, keeping a per-link fault bit vector and an error event counter per link.

kinds.name: Ring stop interface
kinds.description: Inserts and removes flits on a unidirectional ring, giving through-traffic priority over injection, and keeps a ring slot register, an injection queue head and a starvation counter that triggers slot reservation.

kinds.name: 1-Wire bus master
kinds.description: Generates reset/presence, write-slot and read-slot timing on a single open-drain line, keeping a slot timer, a bit counter, a shift register for the current byte and a presence-detected flag.

kinds.name: UART auto-baud detector
kinds.description: Measures the width of the start bit or a known sync character on the receive line to derive a baud divisor, holding an edge-capture timer, a measurement-state register and the resulting divisor register.

kinds.name: UART break detector
kinds.description: Flags a line held low for longer than a full character frame, keeping a low-duration bit-time counter and a sticky break-received status bit.

kinds.name: UART hardware flow control unit
kinds.description: Drives RTS from receive-buffer fill level and gates transmission on sampled CTS, keeping a synchronized CTS register, an RTS output register and programmable assert/deassert threshold registers.

kinds.name: UART receive idle timeout
kinds.description: Signals that received characters are waiting but no new character has arrived for a programmed number of character times, keeping an idle bit-time counter, a timeout-threshold register and a timeout-pending flag.

kinds.name: UART multidrop address matcher
kinds.description: Recognizes 9-bit mode address characters on a shared serial bus and enables data reception only after its own address is seen, holding a station-address register, an address mask and a selected flag.

kinds.name: IrDA SIR encoder/decoder
kinds.description: Converts UART bits to 3/16-bit-time infrared pulses and back, keeping a sixteenth-bit phase counter, a pulse-width register and a received-pulse latch.

kinds.name: LIN bus controller
kinds.description: Sends and receives LIN frames including the break field, sync byte, protected identifier and classic or enhanced checksum, keeping a frame-phase state register, an identifier register, a data buffer and a running checksum register.

kinds.name: I2C start/stop condition detector
kinds.description: Watches SDA transitions while SCL is high to detect START, repeated START and STOP events, holding registered previous SCL/SDA samples and a bus-busy flag.

kinds.name: I2C spike suppression filter
kinds.description: Removes glitches shorter than a programmed width from SCL and SDA inputs, keeping a per-line sample shift register, a stable-output register and a filter-length configuration register.

kinds.name: I2C multi-master arbitration monitor
kinds.description: Compares the value driven on SDA against the sampled bus value during transmission to detect arbitration loss, holding the last driven bit, a lost-arbitration flag and the bit position where loss occurred.

kinds.name: I2C clock-stretch handler
kinds.description: Holds the master's SCL high phase until a slave releases the line and counts how long stretching lasts, keeping a stretch-duration counter, a stretching-active flag and a maximum-stretch limit register.

kinds.name: SMBus timeout and PEC unit
kinds.description: Monitors SMBus transactions for SCL-low timeouts and computes the CRC-8 packet error code over transferred bytes, keeping a low-time counter, a timeout flag and a PEC accumulator register.

kinds.name: I3C dynamic address assignment unit
kinds.description: Runs the ENTDAA procedure, arbitrating on 48-bit provisioned IDs and handing out dynamic addresses, keeping an ID shift register, a next-address register and a table of assigned addresses.

kinds.name: SPI chip-select sequencer
kinds.description: Asserts and deasserts individual slave-select lines with programmable setup, hold and inter-transfer delays, keeping a selected-slave register, a delay counter and a sequencing state register.

kinds.name: Microwire interface
kinds.description: Implements the National Microwire half-duplex serial protocol with start bit, opcode, address and data phases, keeping a phase state register, an opcode/address shift register and a data shift register.

kinds.name: MDIO management master
kinds.description: Issues Clause 22/45 PHY register reads and writes over the MDC/MDIO two-wire interface, keeping a preamble counter, a 32-bit frame shift register, a turnaround phase flag and a read-data register.

kinds.name: Serial Wire Debug target port
kinds.description: Decodes SWD request packets, drives acknowledge and data phases with parity, and handles line turnaround, keeping a request register, a data shift register, a parity accumulator and a protocol-phase register.

kinds.name: Manchester decoder
kinds.description: Recovers data and clock from a Manchester-coded line by timing transitions against expected half and full bit periods, holding an edge-interval counter, the last line level and a decoded-bit shift register.

kinds.name: RS-485 driver-enable controller
kinds.description: Switches a half-duplex transceiver between transmit and receive, asserting driver enable before the first bit and releasing it after the final stop bit with a turnaround delay, keeping an enable register, a guard-time counter and a transmit-active flag.

kinds.name: WS2812 single-wire LED encoder
kinds.description: Translates 24-bit colour words into the timed high/low pulse pattern for addressable LED strings followed by a reset latch interval, keeping a pixel shift register, a bit counter, a pulse-width timer and a reset-gap counter.

kinds.name: Multi-lane deskew buffer
