kinds.description: Aligns data from several lanes by delaying each lane until all have seen a common alignment marker, keeping per-lane delay FIFOs, per-lane marker-seen flags and an aligned flag.

kinds.name: PRBS checker with error counter
kinds.description: Self-synchronizes to an incoming PRBS stream and counts bit mismatches, keeping a local reference shift register, a sync flag and a saturating error counter.

kinds.name: Phase interpolator controller
kinds.description: Accumulates early/late votes into a phase code that steers a receive phase interpolator, keeping a vote integrator, a phase-code register and a frequency-tracking accumulator.

kinds.name: DFE tap adaptation engine
kinds.description: Adjusts decision-feedback equalizer tap weights using sign-sign LMS on slicer errors, keeping a coefficient register per tap, a history of past decided bits and a step-size register.

kinds.name: Eye scan monitor
kinds.description: Measures the receive eye by sampling at offset phases and voltages and comparing with the data slicer, keeping the current horizontal and vertical offset registers, a sample counter and a mismatch counter.

kinds.name: Lane polarity detector
kinds.description: Detects inverted differential pairs by recognizing inverted training symbols and then flips received bits, keeping an inversion flag per lane and a detection counter.

kinds.name: Lane reversal mapper
kinds.description: Remaps logical lane numbers to physical lanes when a link is wired in reverse order, keeping a reversal-enable register and the configured lane-mapping table.

kinds.name: 128b/130b encoder
kinds.description: Prepends a two-bit sync header to each 128-bit data or ordered-set block for PCIe Gen3+, keeping a block-type register, a symbol counter within the block and the staged block data.

kinds.name: MLT-3 encoder
kinds.description: Cycles the line through -1, 0, +1, 0 levels on each one bit for 100BASE-TX, keeping a two-bit level-sequence state register.

kinds.name: 4b/5b encoder
kinds.description: Maps 4-bit nibbles and control codes to 5-bit symbols with guaranteed transitions, keeping a registered input nibble, a control-select flag and the output symbol register.

kinds.name: PAM4 Gray symbol mapper
kinds.description: Groups pairs of bits into Gray-coded four-level PAM4 symbols with optional precoding, keeping a bit-pair staging register and a precoder previous-symbol register.

kinds.name: 2D strided transfer engine
kinds.description: Moves a rectangular region by transferring rows of fixed length and skipping a programmable stride between them, keeping row-length, row-count, source/destination stride and current row/column counters.

kinds.name: Circular buffer DMA channel
kinds.description: Streams data into or out of a ring region in memory, wrapping the address back to the base on reaching the end, with base, size, current-offset and wrap-count registers.

kinds.name: Pattern fill engine
kinds.description: Writes a programmable constant or repeating pattern across a memory region without reading a source, keeping the pattern register, destination pointer and remaining-length counter.

kinds.name: Completion ring writer
kinds.description: Writes completion records with status and transferred length into a host-visible ring after each transfer, keeping ring base, size, producer index and pending-record registers.

kinds.name: Descriptor prefetch cache
kinds.description: Fetches upcoming transfer descriptors ahead of use and holds them in a small local memory, with entry valid bits, tag addresses and a next-fetch pointer.

kinds.name: Channel context store
kinds.description: Saves and restores the full register context of suspended channels so many logical channels share fewer physical engines, using a context RAM indexed by channel number and an active-channel register.

kinds.name: Indexed gather engine
kinds.description: Reads an array of indices from memory and fetches the elements they point to into a dense destination, keeping index pointer, element base, element size and destination pointer registers.

kinds.name: Channel control register block
kinds.description: Exposes software-visible enable, pause, abort and priority controls for each DMA channel, storing per-channel control and status words.

kinds.name: DMA error capture unit
kinds.description: Records the first bus error, descriptor fault or alignment fault seen by a channel, latching the faulting address, error code and channel identifier.

kinds.name: Memory search/compare engine
kinds.description: Scans a memory region comparing each word against a key or a second region and stops on a match or mismatch, keeping key, mask, scan pointer and result-address registers.

kinds.name: Stream-to-memory writer
kinds.description: Accepts a packetized data stream and writes each packet to a memory buffer, recording packet length and end-of-packet status in buffer pointer, byte-count and length-capture registers.

kinds.name: Memory-to-stream reader
kinds.description: Reads a memory buffer and emits it as a stream with start and last markers on packet boundaries, keeping read pointer, remaining-length counter and packet-size registers.

kinds.name: Cache maintenance injector
kinds.description: Issues clean or invalidate operations over the address range a non-coherent DMA transfer touches, holding range start, range end and current line-address registers.

kinds.name: DMA trigger routing matrix
kinds.description: Routes hardware events from peripherals, timers and other channels to selected DMA channel request inputs, holding per-channel trigger-select registers and latched pending-request bits.

kinds.name: Edge-triggered interrupt latch
kinds.description: Captures rising or falling edges on an interrupt input into a sticky pending bit, keeping a previous-sample register and the pending flag until software clears it.

kinds.name: Level-sensitive interrupt gate
kinds.description: Passes an active-level interrupt line through to the controller while it is asserted, keeping a polarity-select register and a sampled-level register.

kinds.name: Programmable priority level array
kinds.description: Assigns a software-written priority value to each interrupt source, holding a per-source priority register array.

kinds.name: In-service register stack
kinds.description: Tracks which interrupt levels a processor is currently servicing to enable nesting, keeping an in-service bit vector and a running-priority register.

kinds.name: Claim/complete gateway
kinds.description: Hands the highest pending interrupt ID to a processor on a claim read and re-arms the source on a complete write, keeping per-source in-flight flags and the last claimed ID.

kinds.name: Vectored interrupt address generator
kinds.description: Forms the handler entry address from a base register plus the winning interrupt number scaled by the entry size, keeping a vector-base register and a vectored-mode bit.

kinds.name: Interrupt routing table
kinds.description: Steers each interrupt source to one or more target processors, holding a per-source target-select or affinity mask register.

kinds.name: MSI-X vector table
kinds.description: Stores per-vector message address, data and mask entries in a RAM and emits a message write when a function signals a vector, keeping a pending-bit array for masked vectors.

kinds.name: Interrupt translation service
kinds.description: Maps a device ID and event ID pair to a physical interrupt number and target collection through cached translation tables, keeping a device table cache and a command queue pointer pair.

kinds.name: Locality-specific peripheral interrupt pending table
kinds.description: Holds a large memory-backed pending and enable bitmap for message interrupts, keeping a property table base register and a cached pending-table slice.

kinds.name: Interrupt coalescing timer
kinds.description: Delays and batches interrupt assertions until either an event count or a time limit is reached, keeping an event counter, a holdoff timer and their programmed limits.

kinds.name: Interrupt rate moderator
kinds.description: Enforces a minimum interval between successive interrupt assertions to a processor, keeping an inter-interrupt countdown and a deferred-pending flag.

kinds.name: Non-maskable interrupt latch
kinds.description: Captures a non-maskable event and holds it until the processor acknowledges, keeping a pending flag and an NMI-in-progress flag that blocks re-entry.

kinds.name: Daisy-chain interrupt acknowledge cell
kinds.description: Passes an interrupt-acknowledge token down a chain of devices so the first requesting device claims it and places its vector on the bus, keeping a request flag and a local vector register.

kinds.name: Cascaded slave controller link
kinds.description: Connects a secondary interrupt controller into one input of a primary controller and forwards the slave's vector on acknowledge, keeping a cascade-identity register and a slave-mode configuration bit.

kinds.name: Interrupt preemption and tail-chaining unit
kinds.description: Decides whether a newly arriving interrupt preempts the running handler or chains directly after it without restoring context, keeping a priority-group split register and the active exception number.

kinds.name: Virtual interrupt list register file
kinds.description: Holds hypervisor-injected virtual interrupts for a guest processor, keeping per-entry virtual ID, priority, state and linked physical ID fields.

kinds.name: Spurious interrupt detector
kinds.description: Returns a reserved spurious vector when a claim finds no qualifying pending interrupt, keeping a spurious-vector register and a spurious-event counter.

kinds.name: Windowed watchdog
kinds.description: Counts down from a reload value and flags a fault if it is serviced either too late or too early, keeping a down-counter, a window-open threshold register, a reload register and an early/late fault status register.

kinds.name: Center-aligned PWM generator
kinds.description: Drives a counter that ramps up then down each period and toggles the output on compare matches in both directions, keeping an up/down counter, a direction bit, a period register and a compare register.

kinds.name: Dead-time complementary PWM
kinds.description: Produces a high-side and low-side output pair from one PWM signal with programmable blanking gaps at each edge, keeping rising and falling dead-time registers, a dead-time countdown counter and the two output state flops.

kinds.name: Input capture unit
kinds.description: Latches the free-running timer value when a selected edge appears on an input pin, keeping an edge-select register, a capture register, a capture-pending flag and an overcapture flag.

kinds.name: Output compare unit
kinds.description: Sets, clears or toggles an output pin when the timer count matches a programmed value, keeping a compare register, an action-mode register and the output pin latch.

kinds.name: Auto-reload timer with preload
kinds.description: Counts to a period value and reloads, with new period and compare values staged in shadow registers that are copied in only at the update event, keeping the active counter, active period, shadow period and an update-pending flag.

kinds.name: Timer event queue
kinds.description: Holds several software-programmed absolute deadlines and fires an event when the free-running time reaches the earliest, keeping a deadline array, per-entry valid bits and a register for the current earliest-deadline index.

kinds.name: Hierarchical timing wheel
kinds.description: Schedules many timeouts in coarse and fine slot rings advanced by a tick, keeping per-level slot pointers, slot occupancy bitmaps and per-slot timer list head registers.

kinds.name: Pulse-width measurement unit
kinds.description: Measures the high time and period of an incoming digital waveform, keeping a running edge-to-edge counter, a captured high-time register, a captured period register and a measurement-ready flag.

kinds.name: Spread-spectrum PWM
kinds.description: Randomly varies the PWM period around a nominal value to spread emitted EMI energy, keeping a period counter, a base-period register, a pseudo-random dither generator state and a dither-depth register.

kinds.name: Dithered high-resolution PWM
kinds.description: Achieves finer-than-clock duty resolution by alternating the duty between adjacent integer values across periods, keeping a period counter, an integer duty register, a fractional duty register and a fractional error accumulator.

kinds.name: Programmable delay pulse generator
kinds.description: Outputs a pulse of programmed width starting a programmed delay after an input trigger, keeping a delay register, a width register, a phase counter and a delay/width/idle phase register.

kinds.name: Multi-phase interleaved PWM
kinds.description: Generates several PWM channels sharing one period but each shifted by a programmable phase offset, keeping a master period counter, per-channel phase-offset registers and per-channel duty registers.

kinds.name: PWM fault trip latch
kinds.description: Forces PWM outputs to a safe state on an external fault input and holds them there until software clears it, keeping a fault latch, a safe-state output pattern register and a fault-clear/rearm control register.

kinds.name: LED breathing engine
kinds.description: Smoothly ramps a PWM duty value up and down to fade an LED, keeping a PWM counter, a current-duty register, a ramp-step register, a ramp-rate prescale counter and a ramp-direction bit.

kinds.name: Gated event counter
kinds.description: Counts external input edges only while a gate input is asserted and latches the total when the gate closes, keeping an edge counter, a gate-state flop and a latched-result register.

kinds.name: CRC residue checker
kinds.description: Runs received data and its appended CRC through a feedback shift register and flags an error at end of frame, keeping the running remainder register and a frame-done/error flag.

kinds.name: Fletcher checksum unit
kinds.description: Computes a Fletcher checksum over a byte stream using two modular running-sum registers that are updated on every input word.

kinds.name: Reed-Solomon syndrome calculator
kinds.description: Evaluates the received codeword at each root of the generator polynomial using a bank of Horner-rule GF multiply-accumulate registers, one per syndrome.

kinds.name: Berlekamp-Massey solver
kinds.description: Iteratively derives the error-locator polynomial from syndromes, keeping coefficient registers for the current and previous locator polynomials, a discrepancy register and a length/step counter.

kinds.name: Chien search unit
kinds.description: Tests every field element as a root of the error-locator polynomial by stepping per-coefficient GF multiplier registers each cycle and recording root positions in a position counter and hit flags.

kinds.name: Forney error evaluator
kinds.description: Computes error magnitudes at located positions from the error-evaluator polynomial and locator derivative, holding polynomial coefficient registers and a pending-correction output register.

kinds.name: Golay code encoder/decoder
kinds.description: Encodes 12-bit words into 24-bit extended Golay codewords and corrects up to three bit errors via syndrome lookup, keeping a syndrome register and a decode lookup table.

kinds.name: LDPC check-node processor
kinds.description: Computes min-sum check-to-variable messages for one parity-check row, storing the running minimum, second minimum, minimum index and sign-product registers.

kinds.name: LDPC variable-node processor
kinds.description: Sums channel log-likelihoods with incoming check messages to produce updated beliefs and hard decisions, keeping a per-node LLR memory and a posterior accumulator.

kinds.name: Viterbi branch metric unit
kinds.description: Computes Hamming or Euclidean distances between received soft symbols and each possible encoder output, latching the metrics in a branch-metric register bank.

kinds.name: Viterbi traceback unit
kinds.description: Walks backward through stored survivor decision bits from a chosen state to output decoded bits, holding a survivor-path memory, a traceback state register and a read pointer.

kinds.name: Turbo SISO decoder
kinds.description: Runs the max-log-MAP forward and backward recursions over a trellis to produce extrinsic information, storing alpha state-metric memory, beta registers and an extrinsic LLR buffer.

kinds.name: Polar successive-cancellation decoder
kinds.description: Decodes polar codes by traversing a binary tree of f/g LLR operations, keeping an LLR memory per tree stage, partial-sum registers and a frozen-bit mask ROM.

kinds.name: Convolutional interleaver
kinds.description: Spreads burst errors by delaying successive symbols through branches of increasing length, implemented with per-branch delay memories and a commutator branch counter.

kinds.name: ECC error logger
kinds.description: Captures details of detected memory errors for software, holding syndrome, failing-address and error-type capture registers plus correctable and uncorrectable error counters.

kinds.name: Two-dimensional parity checker
kinds.description: Computes row and column parity over a data block to locate and flip a single erroneous bit, keeping a row-parity register and a column-parity accumulator register.

kinds.name: Chipkill symbol-correcting decoder
kinds.description: Corrects failure of an entire DRAM device by treating each chip's bits as one symbol of a symbol-based code, keeping a syndrome register and a failed-chip identifier register.

kinds.name: RAID-6 P+Q parity engine
kinds.description: Generates XOR parity P and Galois-field weighted parity Q across data stripes to tolerate two erasures, holding P and Q accumulator buffers and a stripe-index counter.

kinds.name: Lockstep duplicate-and-compare checker
kinds.description: Runs two copies of a logic block on the same inputs and raises a fault on any output mismatch, keeping a registered mismatch flag and a sticky error-status register.

kinds.name: Residue-code arithmetic checker
kinds.description: Checks adder or multiplier results by computing a mod-3 residue of the operands and result in parallel, holding operand residue registers and a residue-mismatch flag.

kinds.name: Composite-field AES S-box
kinds.description: Computes the AES SubBytes substitution by mapping bytes into GF((2^4)^2), inverting there and mapping back with the affine transform, optionally keeping pipeline registers between the isomorphism, inversion and output stages.

kinds.name: GHASH multiplier
kinds.description: Performs the GF(2^128) multiply-and-accumulate used for AES-GCM authentication, holding the hash subkey H and the running 128-bit tag accumulator.

kinds.name: XTS tweak generator
kinds.description: Produces per-block tweaks for AES-XTS storage encryption by repeatedly multiplying an encrypted sector tweak by alpha in GF(2^128), keeping the current tweak value and a block index register.

kinds.name: CBC chaining controller
kinds.description: Wraps a block cipher core to implement CBC encryption and decryption by XORing data with the previous ciphertext, storing the IV/chaining register and a mode/direction register.

kinds.name: CTR counter-block generator
kinds.description: Builds successive counter blocks from a nonce and an incrementing counter for counter-mode keystream generation, holding the nonce register, the counter register and a keystream buffer.

kinds.name: Keccak-f permutation core
kinds.description: Executes the theta, rho, pi, chi and iota steps of the Keccak-f[1600] permutation for SHA-3 and SHAKE, keeping the 5x5 lane state array and a round index counter.

kinds.name: Sponge absorb/squeeze controller
kinds.description: Manages rate-sized absorption of message blocks into a sponge state and later squeezing of output, tracking the byte offset within the rate, the domain-separation suffix and an absorb/squeeze phase register.

kinds.name: SHA-2 message schedule expander
kinds.description: Generates the per-round message words for SHA-256 from the input block using the sigma functions, keeping a sliding window of the 16 most recent schedule words.

kinds.name: Hash padding unit
kinds.description: Appends the Merkle-Damgard padding bit, zero fill and big-endian message length to the final message block, keeping a 64- or 128-bit total-length counter and a byte-position register.

kinds.name: HMAC sequencer
kinds.description: Drives an underlying hash core through the inner and outer passes of HMAC with ipad/opad-XORed keys, storing the padded key, the inner digest and a pass-phase register.

kinds.name: MD5 round core
kinds.description: Computes the 64 MD5 operations over a 512-bit block using the F, G, H, I functions and per-step constants, holding the four 32-bit chaining variables and a step counter.

kinds.name: DES Feistel round unit
kinds.description: Performs DES/3DES rounds with expansion, S-box substitution and P-permutation on the right half, keeping left and right half registers, the rotating C/D key halves and a round counter.

kinds.name: SM4 round unit
kinds.description: Executes the 32 unbalanced-Feistel rounds of the SM4 block cipher with its nonlinear tau and linear L transforms, holding four 32-bit word registers and the round-key schedule state.

kinds.name: BLAKE2 G-function core
kinds.description: Applies the BLAKE2 mixing function across columns and diagonals of the 4x4 working vector with permuted message words, storing the working vector, chaining value and byte offset counter.

kinds.name: Trivium stream cipher core
kinds.description: Generates keystream bits from three coupled nonlinear shift registers totaling 288 bits, holding that register state and a warm-up cycle counter used during initialization.

kinds.name: Poly1305 accumulator
kinds.description: Computes the Poly1305 one-time MAC by adding message blocks to an accumulator and multiplying by the clamped key r modulo 2^130-5, keeping the r and s key registers and the 130-bit accumulator.

kinds.name: Elliptic-curve point adder/doubler
kinds.description: Performs point addition and doubling in projective or Jacobian coordinates by sequencing field multiplications and additions, holding the X, Y, Z coordinate registers of the operands and temporaries.

kinds.name: Montgomery ladder scalar multiplier
kinds.description: Computes elliptic-curve scalar multiplication by scanning scalar bits and performing a uniform add-and-double step each bit, keeping the two ladder point registers, the scalar register and a bit-index counter.

kinds.name: RSA CRT recombination unit
kinds.description: Combines the two half-size exponentiation results modulo p and q into the full RSA result using Garner's formula, storing the partial results, the qInv coefficient and an output register.

kinds.name: NTT butterfly unit
kinds.description: Performs Cooley-Tukey/Gentleman-Sande butterflies modulo a small prime for lattice-based post-quantum schemes such as Kyber and Dilithium, holding coefficient operand registers, the current twiddle factor and stage/index counters.

kinds.name: TRNG health-test monitor
kinds.description: Runs continuous repetition-count and adaptive-proportion tests on raw entropy samples, keeping the last sample, a repeat counter, a window sample counter and an alarm flag.

kinds.name: Von Neumann debiaser
kinds.description: Removes bias from a raw random bitstream by examining non-overlapping bit pairs and emitting one bit for each unequal pair, storing the pending first bit of a pair and an output-valid flag.

kinds.name: CTR_DRBG state engine
kinds.description: Implements the NIST SP 800-90A counter-mode deterministic random bit generator with instantiate, reseed and generate operations, holding the internal key, the V counter block and a reseed counter.

kinds.name: Secure key slot vault
kinds.description: Stores cryptographic keys in a bank of write-only slots that feed cipher cores directly without software readback, keeping per-slot key registers, usage-permission bits and sticky lock bits.

kinds.name: Lattice filter
kinds.description: Filters a stream through cascaded lattice stages, each combining forward and backward prediction errors using reflection coefficients, and stores a backward-error delay register per stage plus a coefficient register file.

kinds.name: LMS adaptive filter
kinds.description: Runs an FIR filter whose taps are updated every sample from the product of the error signal, the step size and the delayed input, keeping an input delay line, a tap-weight register array and the latest error value.

kinds.name: Goertzel tone detector
kinds.description: Measures the energy of one frequency bin over a block of samples with a second-order recursion, keeping two state registers, a sample counter and a coefficient register.

kinds.name: Hilbert transformer
kinds.description: Produces a 90-degree phase-shifted quadrature copy of a real input with an antisymmetric FIR, holding a delay line of input samples and a matched delay that aligns the in-phase output.

kinds.name: Complex digital mixer
kinds.description: Multiplies incoming I/Q samples by a complex local-oscillator sample to shift the signal in frequency, holding pipeline registers for the four partial products and the summed outputs.

kinds.name: DC-blocking filter
kinds.description: Removes the DC offset from a stream with a first-order high-pass recursion, keeping the previous input sample and the previous output sample in registers.

kinds.name: Farrow fractional-delay interpolator
kinds.description: Produces samples at arbitrary fractional positions by evaluating a polynomial in the fractional delay over sub-filter outputs, keeping a shared input delay line, the sub-filter output registers and a fractional-mu register.

kinds.name: Costas loop phase discriminator
kinds.description: Estimates the carrier phase error from derotated I/Q samples using sign-and-multiply products for carrier recovery, keeping the last derotated sample pair and a registered error output.

kinds.name: Gardner timing error detector
kinds.description: Computes a symbol-timing error from the current and previous symbol samples and the midpoint sample between them, storing those samples in a small history register set and a strobe phase flag.

kinds.name: Sliding DFT bin
kinds.description: Updates one DFT bin on every new sample by adding the newest sample, subtracting the oldest and applying a complex twiddle rotation, keeping an N-deep sample history buffer and a complex bin accumulator.

kinds.name: R2SDF FFT stage
kinds.description: Performs one stage of a pipelined radix-2 single-delay-feedback FFT, routing samples through a feedback delay memory into a butterfly, with a stage control counter that toggles between fill and compute modes.

kinds.name: Alpha-max-beta-min magnitude estimator
kinds.description: Approximates the magnitude of a complex sample by taking the larger and smaller absolute components and combining them with fixed weights, holding registered absolute values and the estimate.

kinds.name: RMS power meter
kinds.description: Measures signal power by squaring samples, accumulating them over a programmable window and outputting the mean square or its root, keeping a sum-of-squares accumulator, a window counter and a result register.

kinds.name: Exponential moving-average filter
kinds.description: Smooths a stream with a leaky integrator that adds a shifted fraction of the difference between the input and the current average, keeping a single extended-precision average register and a shift-amount setting.

kinds.name: Feedback comb filter
kinds.description: Creates echo or resonance by adding a scaled, delayed copy of the output back to the input, keeping a circular delay memory, its write pointer and a feedback gain register.

kinds.name: Schroeder allpass section
kinds.description: Disperses phase without changing magnitude, as used in reverberators, by combining feedforward and feedback paths around a long delay, keeping a circular delay buffer, a pointer and a gain coefficient.

kinds.name: TPDF dither generator
kinds.description: Adds triangular-probability noise, formed from two pseudo-random values, to samples before word-length reduction, keeping the two random generator states and a registered dithered output.

kinds.name: Overlap-add block convolver
kinds.description: Convolves a long stream with a filter by processing input blocks and summing the overlapping tail of each block result into the next, keeping a block input buffer, an overlap tail memory and a block counter.

kinds.name: Zero-crossing pitch estimator
kinds.description: Estimates the fundamental period of a signal by timing the intervals between sign changes, keeping the previous sample sign, a running interval counter and the last measured period register.

kinds.name: IQ imbalance corrector
kinds.description: Compensates gain and phase mismatch between the I and Q branches by applying a correction matrix to each complex sample, holding programmable gain and phase coefficients and pipelined corrected outputs.

kinds.name: Constellation slicer
kinds.description: Maps each received complex symbol to the nearest constellation point and outputs the decided bits plus the decision error vector, holding the configured modulation order and registered decision and error values.

kinds.name: Welch spectral averager
kinds.description: Averages power spectra across successive FFT frames by accumulating squared bin magnitudes in per-bin memory, keeping the bin accumulation RAM, a bin index counter and a frame counter.

kinds.name: Dynamic range compressor
kinds.description: Reduces audio dynamic range by tracking the signal envelope and applying a gain reduction above a threshold with attack and release smoothing, keeping an envelope register, a current gain register and the threshold and ratio parameters.

kinds.name: Tournament branch predictor
kinds.description: Combines a local-history predictor and a global-history predictor through a chooser table of saturating counters that selects which component's prediction to use, keeping a local history table, two pattern tables and the chooser array.

kinds.name: TAGE branch predictor
kinds.description: Predicts branch direction from several tagged tables indexed by geometrically increasing global-history lengths, keeping per-entry tags, prediction counters, usefulness bits and a base bimodal table.

kinds.name: Perceptron branch predictor
kinds.description: Computes a dot product of signed weights with global history bits to predict a branch and trains the weights on mispredictions, keeping a table of weight vectors and a history register.

kinds.name: Loop predictor
kinds.description: Recognizes branches that close fixed-trip-count loops and predicts the exit iteration, keeping per-entry tags, learned trip counts, current iteration counts and confidence counters.

kinds.name: Indirect target predictor
kinds.description: Predicts targets of register-indirect jumps by hashing the branch address with path history into a tagged target table, keeping target addresses, tags and a path-history register.

kinds.name: Speculative history checkpoint unit
kinds.description: Updates the global branch history speculatively at prediction time and restores it on misprediction, keeping the speculative history register and a set of per-branch history snapshots.

kinds.name: Fetch target queue
kinds.description: Decouples the branch predictor from the instruction cache by queuing predicted fetch blocks, keeping per-entry start addresses, predicted targets and branch metadata for later resolution.

kinds.name: Next-line predictor
kinds.description: Provides a single-cycle guess of the next fetch address and way from the current fetch line, keeping a small table of next-line indices, way hints and valid bits.

kinds.name: Compressed instruction expander
kinds.description: Translates 16-bit compressed instruction encodings into their equivalent 32-bit forms ahead of decode, keeping a halfword holding register for instructions that straddle fetch boundaries.

kinds.name: Instruction length decoder
kinds.description: Scans a byte stream of variable-length instructions to mark instruction boundaries and extract aligned instructions, keeping a byte buffer, boundary marker bits and a carry-over offset register.

kinds.name: Macro-op fusion unit
kinds.description: Detects adjacent instruction pairs such as compare-and-branch and merges them into one internal operation, keeping a lookahead slot holding the previous decoded instruction.

kinds.name: Branch mask allocator
kinds.description: Assigns each in-flight speculative branch a tag bit and broadcasts kill or clear signals when branches resolve, keeping a free-tag vector and per-instruction branch dependency masks.

kinds.name: Age matrix selector
kinds.description: Picks the oldest ready instruction among issue queue entries using a pairwise older-than bit matrix, keeping the age matrix and per-entry ready bits.

kinds.name: Dependency matrix wakeup unit
kinds.description: Wakes waiting instructions when their producers issue by consulting a matrix of producer-consumer dependency bits, keeping the dependency matrix and per-entry pending-source flags.

kinds.name: Register busy-bit table
kinds.description: Tracks for each physical or architectural register whether its value is still being produced, keeping one busy bit per register that is set at dispatch and cleared at writeback.

kinds.name: Store-set dependence predictor
kinds.description: Predicts which loads depend on which earlier stores so loads can issue speculatively but wait on likely conflicts, keeping a store-set ID table and a last-fetched-store table.

kinds.name: Load replay unit
kinds.description: Re-issues loads and their dependents when a speculative cache-hit assumption or memory ordering check fails, keeping a replay queue of instruction tags and replay-reason codes.

kinds.name: Branch resolution unit
kinds.description: Evaluates branch conditions and targets in execute, compares them with the prediction and triggers redirect and flush, keeping the predicted target, prediction metadata and a redirect address register.

kinds.name: Value predictor
kinds.description: Predicts the result of long-latency instructions such as loads from their prior outcomes, keeping a table of last values, strides and confidence counters indexed by instruction address.

kinds.name: Fine-grained thread scheduler
kinds.description: Selects one hardware thread per cycle to fetch or issue in an interleaved multithreaded pipeline, keeping per-thread program counters, ready flags and a rotating selection pointer.

kinds.name: Zero-overhead loop controller
kinds.description: Executes hardware loops without branch instructions by redirecting fetch at the loop end address, keeping loop start, loop end and iteration count registers for each nesting level.

kinds.name: Writeback port arbiter
kinds.description: Schedules which completing functional units may use the limited register-file write ports in each cycle, keeping a result-bus reservation shift register of booked future writeback slots.
